notes.title: Clone Drone in the Hyperdome is coming December 12th for VR!
notes.content:
[h1]Clone Drone in the Hyperdome[/h1]
[previewyoutube=Lak9cQqVsrM;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello Humans!

Thank you for all your support in these many years of development. We are so happy to show you the new trailer and tell you the release date for Clone Drone in the Hyperdome.

In Clone Drone in the Hyperdome, sword fight with killer robots in an all-out VR tournament of death! You are Blink, a teleporting robot who is the newest “looprunner” gladiator forced to compete in Crashloop, a deadly roguelike combat sport. Die and reawaken in an endless loop, leap over lava pools, avoid turret fire, take down waves of enemy defendroids, and feel your sword disintegrate their metal bodies. Deal damage exactly where your cut lands using our stunning voxel combat engine! To win your freedom, battle your fellow looprunners for a chance to fight the Captain in the Hyperdome…

[h3]Combat Precision & Epic Voxel Destruction[/h3] The ability to cut robots with swords has never felt better! Players can slice robots arms, legs, and heads off with their sword precisely where they aimed, but they’ll need to be careful because their enemies can do the same to them. 
[h3]Incredible Weapon Selection[/h3] Inside the Crashloop, players can choose from a wide variety of weapons, including broadswords, scythes, axes, and shields. Every looprunner mini-boss has their own unique weapon called a turbofist, which players can acquire by defeating them in duels or triple threat matches. 
[h3]Combat Relationships [/h3] After a run in the Crashloop, players are sent back to the loading room, where they’ll confront the same looprunners they just battled. The player’s decisions of who they attacked and when will determine their relationships with the other looprunners.
[h3]Roguelike Tournament to the Death[/h3] The player is the newest looprunner in the Crashloop, a deadly combat arena that changes every run through. To win a run in Crashloop, the player must be the last survivor of the tournament, where they battle other looprunners to the death, so they can move on to fight The Captain in the Hyperdome.
[h3]All New Gameplay Experience, Fit for VR [/h3] The Clone Drone in the Hyperdome experience, building off the success of Doborog’s indie hit Clone Drone in the Danger Zone, brings robot fighting to VR with new content, characters, story and more. The game has been built from the ground up to push what it's possible to do in VR forward, such as implementing physics based sword combat and interactions optimized for the best VR gameplay experience. 

Clone Drone in the Hyperdome is launching on [b]December 12th, 2024[/b] and will be available on the Meta Store for [b]Oculus 2 and 3 [/b]and Steam for [b]PC VR[/b].

[b]Wishlist[/b] the game on Meta Store and Steam here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401230/Clone_Drone_in_the_Hyperdome
https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/clone-drone-in-the-hyperdome/4523126804481573/

We also know a lot of you are excited to see updates for Clone Drone in the Danger Zone, and so are we! Right now we're focused fully on finishing Clone Drone in the Hyperdome for you but we will tell you more after release! Until then we highly recommend all the incredible mods that you can find on mod-bot. The modders and artists of this community are really talented and have added amazing things to the game.

All the best,
Team Doborog

notes.title: The 2024 Apocalypse Competition
notes.content:
Welcome to our 2024 competition!
The theme is...
[h1]APOCALYPSE[/h1]
There are lots of things you can do with this theme! Try to include it in your art, level or animation. It could be asteroids or robot invasion or anything else that the theme "Apocalypse" makes you think!

[h2]Rules[/h2]
[list]
[*]It must be your own work.
[*]It must be created after the start of the competition.
[*]No AI images, videos or anything else. Anything made with AI will be disqualified.
[*]You can work together in groups, if a group project wins, all participants will have the option of a prize.
[*]You can submit as many entries as you would like, you are only eligible for one prize
[*]Length: 2 Months. Runs from Tuesday 23rd July to Sunday 22nd September at 11pm England Time.
[*]Judging: Up to 1 month from Sunday 22nd September, depending on the number of entries. 
[*]Winners will be picked by the Doborog Team and Community Judges except for the Community Prize which will be voted on by the community.
[/list]
[h2]Categories[/h2]
There will be 3 Winners of each category. One win per entry. Judges from the community will help pick the Animation, Art and Level Editor winners! Our Community Judges are Nook and A TVCat.
[h3]Animation[/h3]
        A video entry animated with the level editor or 2D or 3D animation software. Submitted as a link from YouTube, BiliBili or Vimeo. This is both for safety and so that the community can easily find them to vote in the Community Choice Award.
[h3]Art[/h3]
        Can be screenshots, 3D renders, drawn physically or digitally.
[h3]Level Editor Award[/h3]
        This is for Challenge type levels only.
[h3]Community Choice Award[/h3]
        The community’s pick of all entries. Animations, Art and Challenge Levels.
[h3]Doborog’s Choice Award[/h3]
        Team Doborog pick their favourites.
[h2]Prizes[/h2]
        Everyone who enters will get the “Everyone Wins when you’re having fun” and "Rest in Pieces” Emotes.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/d7151460a3df81be4091cd93eb381aa9916afd2e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/aaca6a6bc4923d066d4765c8ad6604e57f4b5621.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/439a467c63d1b11454c773ff7b7b249b26035f3b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/f767677d0ad6009024e5ce0c46d46b7e8e07b8ce.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/350a9dada284d2119d80101d1853d87bd01a4ee4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/3e69bd93700efee7f182dee46c5bebc43bb03b79.png[/img][/url]

Winners of the awards will get:
[list]
[*]A choice of one of Human, Spidertron or Garbage Bot Plushie
Plushie prizes are subject to limited numbers and location. We may run out of some Plushies. Russians will be unable to receive these because of delivery restrictions. Instead Russian winners will have the option of a free Clone Drone game key.
[*]The “Good Luck, Have Fun” and other Emotes
[*]Shared on official Social Media and in Front page Level Editor collection
[/list]
The Competition starts [b]NOW![/b]
Make sure you get your entry in before Sunday 22nd September at 11pm England time. Use this link to send us your entry:
(The competition has ended, thank you to everyone that joined!)

Best of Luck!
The Doborog Team

notes.title: Imagine Chapter 6 Level Editor Competition
notes.content:
Hello Humans!
It’s that time again, we are hosting a new Level Editor Competition with some cool prizes! This time we want you to be able to make anything you want and you have LOTS of time to do it.
[h1]The Imagine Chapter 6 Level Editor Competition[/h1]
[b]Have you ever wondered what happens after the end of the Clone Drone Story mode?[/b] You can make an animation, story, battle or anything else you can imagine as long as the level you create is an Adventure or Challenge type Level. The submission deadline is [b]September 10th[/b].
[h3]Rules and Requirements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] All entries must be a Challenge or Adventure Level.
[*] Can focus on anything including animation, fights, building, art, jumping puzzles.
[*] All levels of experience are welcome and have a chance to win.
[*] One entry per person.
[*] You may work with someone else. If you submit a co-op entry, you cannot enter any other levels.
[*] Your entry must be created by you.
[*] We will disqualify any inappropriate entries.
[/list]
[h3]Prizes for All Entries:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Everyone Wins Emote
[/list]
[h3]Prizes for Our Favourites:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Good Luck, Have Fun Emote
[*] Display in the steam workshop level collection
[/list]
If you have any questions email support@doborog.com or ask in our Discord https://discord.gg/doborog.


When you are finished, submit your level here before the submission deadline of [b]September 10th[/b]: https://inj5jehpdl0.typeform.com/to/cfS7FXXR


We can’t wait to see your creations. Good luck!
The Doborog Team

notes.title: 1.4.0.23 - A few Level Editor bug fixes!
notes.content:
We just released a tiny Steam update with a few level editor bugfixes:

[list]
[*] Fix decimal point input bugs in position/rotation/scale and decimal input fields. Fixes a bug in Unity (!!) where you cannot insert a decimal if a decimal is in your text selection. [/list]

May your level editing be crash-free and even more undo-able! 🙏

notes.title: The "Beginners Welcome" Level Editor Competition!
notes.content:
Hello Humans!

We have made a series of videos on how to make fun levels with the level editor, so we thought it would be the perfect time for a new Level Editor Competition!

[h1]The Beginners Welcome Level Competition[/h1]

This competition is to encourage everyone to make levels so the new "Rest in Pieces" Emote reward will go to everyone who submits a level!

If you have an idea for a level, try to make it! We are not looking for perfection, just levels that try to be fun.

We will pick our favorite level from each of [b]Endless Mode[/b], [b]Adventure Mode[/b], [b]Last Bot Standing[/b] and [b]Challenge Mode[/b]. This means that you can make whatever you want, we will be looking for fun ideas and even if they aren't perfect you still have a chance to be featured!

[h2]The competition starts NOW and ends on Monday 28th March at 23:00 GMT.[/h2]

To our veteran Level creators this might not seem like a very long time, but for this competition, try to work on small, focused ideas that you can finish in a week!

If you don't know where to start with the Level Editor, watch this playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PvEAHpLN5yA&list=PLjNMhukbgXKsxoxjIwtfv8vIPV8z4iMB9

For more information on how to make an Adventure Mode level, start here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZrtH57SIaDI&list=PLjNMhukbgXKsxoxjIwtfv8vIPV8z4iMB9&index=9

If you want info on making a Last Bot Standing Level, read this
https://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/how-to-make-a-great-last-bot-standing-level/

Do you want feedback on your level? Do you want to know if something specific is fun? Make sure you mention that in the workshop description. The Doborog team and the community will write helpful notes in the comments!

[h2]Emotes![/h2]
Everyone who enters a level into the competition will get the special "Rest in Pieces" Emote! 

The creators of the levels we feature will get the "Good Luck, Have fun" Emote!

Any community members that write a helpful comment will get access to the "Everyone is a Winner when you have Fun" Emote.
Please remember that not everyone will ask for feedback. If they do, they will put it in the description of their level. When you are writing a comment, describe what you think in more specific words than "good" or "bad". This will really help everyone get better at making levels that you enjoy!

As usual, it is OK if you want to work on your level with other people, or multiple levels as long as everyone's name is mentioned in the description.

Please only submit levels that have been created after the start of this competition.

[h2]Submit your level here![/h2]
When you are done, put the link to your level here: https://inj5jehpdl0.typeform.com/to/plDEFCjy

Good luck and have fun level editing!
- Josh, Community Manager

notes.title: Multiplayer Server Update - With more regions!
notes.content:
Hello Humans,

We have updated our multiplayer servers! While we hope that this will make them more stable, we have had to make a lot of changes to make them work on the new service, so we need your help to make sure they work properly!

But first, the best news... MORE SERVER REGIONS!

We have added [b]US West[/b],[b] EU East [/b]and [b]Asia East[/b] servers! These locations give players in those areas servers that are closer to them. Unfortunately we had to remove the Singapore server region but the Asia East server region will cover those people that used it and hopefully mean the matches have more people in them!

The full list of available regions is now:
[list]
[*]Asia East
[*]Australia
[*]Brazil
[*]EU East
[*]EU West
[*]Japan
[*]US East
[*]US West
[/list]
[h2]Help us check the servers work for you![/h2]

We have tested these new servers as much as we can but multiplayer issues can be really specific to your local internet connection. We would love to know if the online performance of the game is better or worse for you.

If you encounter any of the below, please submit a bug report:
[list]
[*]Does matchmaking not work for you?
[*]Does your game get laggy when your ping is still low?
[*]Does your co-op match crash after a long time?
[/list]

You can send us a bug report via email bugs@doborog.com or on our Discord in the #cddz-bug-reports chat. As always with bug reports, if you can send us a video of your problem, that makes it a lot easier for us to understand how to fix it!

We plan on continuing to improve the servers and matchmaking over time, so any feedback is super helpful. Thanks to all who have helped us make the game better with your bug reports and feedback so far!

- Josh, Doborog Community Manager

[*] The Emperor and zombies no longer die instantly when you separate the torso from hips!
[*] Fixed issue where legs would stay attached when you damaged the connection between torso and hips from above.
[*] Fixed the workshop browser crashing when updated quickly on a slower connection
[*] Imperial Armor Bots can now appear in Workshop Levels!
[*] Fire traps shooting fire no longer alert enemies in stealth game mode.
[*] Emperor Shockwave and grenades no longer crash the game if they happen next to enemies hidden by sections
[*] Added a few missing translations in Korean and Traditional Chinese
[/list]
No major changes other than that.

As always, if you find bugs or experience crashes, feel free to email us at bugs@doborog.com, make a forum thread, or post about it in our [url=https://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/discord]discord[/url]

Cheers,
Erik

notes.title: Multiplayer Hotfix - 1.0.0.29
notes.content:
We just pushed a fix for multiplayer not connecting which began occurring about 18 hours ago. Let us know if you are still unable to connect to multiplayer for any reason, making sure to [url=https://support.doborog.com/l/en/clone-drone/game-version-check-update]confirm your game version is updated to 1.0.0.29[/url].

[h2]What needed fixing?[/h2]

Around 10pm EST Tuesday we noticed a majority of player connections began failing. After investigating we learned from our multiplayer networking service provider that a service they relied on went down and would require a client-side patch to hotfix their library. So we had to update the game client to fix it!

[h2]What about consoles?[/h2]

We are submitting the same fix to Switch and PS4 shortly and asking for emergency patch review, but it may depend on how long their reviews take, fingers crossed!

Xbox should be uninterrupted, let us know if you do see any issues connecting to games. Cross-play should also still be intact!

[h2]Why did resolving it take the whole day?[/h2]

We were waiting for our partner to completely fix the problem with a patch fix, which just came in 45 mins ago - so we got it implemented, re-tested and pushed it live just now!

Thanks to everyone who let us know about this issue early, and for everyone’s patience while we got this sorted out!

notes.title: Hotfix: Minor Performance Optimization!
notes.content:
Hello humans!

Our previous update tweaked some subtle stuff around physics that led to a decrease in character movement speed for some players.

We just updated the "maximum allowed timestep" to strike a better balance between maintaining a consistent framerate while making sure the physics simulation is not too dependent on the visual framerate.

Let us know if you notice anything different!

Cheers,
Erik

notes.title: Future Plans + Patch released!
notes.content:
Hello Humans!

We just released a little Patch that fixes a wide variety of bugs and add a few improvements to the game. Read more about the details in the second half of this blog post!

[h1]What's next for Clone Drone??[/h1]

Since many of you are curious, let's talk about what are plans are for the future!

[h2]Adventure Levels[/h2]
In the immediate future, we're going to be focusing on expanding the capabilities of the Level Editor, creating a new type of level that takes place completely outside of the Arena!

Levels that quickly leave the arena to have a fantastic adventure elsewhere is a pretty common scenario among the more elaborate levels created by the community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/7587852f9bb3f2f75c05aad19c2757b996c35ba7.png[/img]

We're really excited to see what everyone makes when this constraint is removed. We'll also be looking into things like checkpoints, saving progress etc. to let you make things that are similar in structure to our own Story Mode levels.

If this makes you at all excited, join us [url=https://www.twitch.tv/doborog]on Twitch[/url] where we'll be streaming the building of this feature! :)

[h2]Workshop Curation / Competitions![/h2]
The other side of our Level Editor focus is that we'll be looking into ways of supporting more official Level Editing Competitions, and find cool ways to highlight high quality workshop content that stands out from the crowd.

We really enjoy the energy of people coming together to make cool stuff, and want to set up systems that facilitate that happening on a regular basis. 

Next competition coming up will be for Halloween, but don't start making your levels yet. We'll likely make this one lean on our new format taking place outside of the Arena. :)

[h2]Server Stability / Performance[/h2]
In parallel to new feature development we are investigating ways to make our servers more performant and more reliable. This is a huge undertaking that involves overhauling how pretty much everything works in terms of hosting and matchmaking, so it might take a while, and comes with a healthy does of uncertainty in terms of specific outcomes.

Nevertheless this is something we feel could be better in the game right now, and we have some promising investigations in the works. More info about that when we have it!

[h2]Next game!??!?[/h2]
At some point in the next few months we'll start exploring what games we're making next! We'll still be working on some Clone Drone things at the same time, but if you see us start to work on weird things that have no robots or laser swords, this might be what's happening. ;)

[h2]New Multiplayer Game Modes[/h2]
It's maybe a bit early to talk about the specifics of this, but let's just say we are addicted to game modes and have plans to explore more of them!

What kind of game modes??? We'll likely experiment with more than one type to see what ends up being fun. Let us know what you'd be excited about in the comments!



[h1]Patch Notes![/h1]
ok, so that was a lot of info about the future. What did we do in the last few weeks? 
We made this patch that just went out! (1.0.0.24)

[h2]Emperor Combat Tweaks![/h2]
So right after launch you had a lot of feedback on the Emperor, especially on Insane difficulty!

For our immediate hotfix we didn't change the Emperor at all, but with this one we took the time to improve the fight in the following ways:
[list]
[*] Jump damage: No longer active at the start of the jump! No longer active directly after he lands.
[*] Shockwave attack: Decreased the radius slightly, and increased the cooldown before next use.
[*] Imperial Armor Bots: No longer give armor or shoot down arrows while they're being constructed!
[/list]
In addition to these changes, we also changed the amount of energy you have when mind transferred into robots! Both spear1 and sword1 now have 2 energy bars instead of 1, which makes confronting difficult enemies slightly less impossible with them. It also increases the tempo for both Chapter 4 and 5, so overall we think it's a pretty fun change!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/87aceff2b1e479be5a5e477eb8724089eab31196.gif[/img]

[h2]Performance improvements![/h2]
A focus for this release was to increase performance across the board. While many of these changes might be primarily felt in our console patches that also went out today, you might feel the improvements in the Steam version as well.

[h2]PlayStation / Switch: Full gyro support![/h2]
Do you enjoy having Gyro on all the time? We've added a setting to allow you to always turn your controller to turn the camera, as opposed to it only being active when using the bow.

[h2]Bug fixes![/h2]
[list]
[*] Music cutting out! We fixed the music sometimes cutting out when a lot of sounds were playing at once.
[*] Fixed a crash from your laser raptor friend lasering things in the central corridor of Chapter 5.
[*] The Emperor can now jump on jump pads without getting stuck
[*] Removed energy bar from end of chapter 3 cutscene.
[*] First Emperor confrontation in Chapter 5 now correctly resets your mind transfers.
[*] Chapter 5 Insane achievement: We had some reports of it not unlocking for people, and made the way we do that a bit more reliable.
[*] Fixed spectator mode not allowing you to switch character when using controller!
[*] Emperor skin had a bug where the legs would not fall off when cut in multiplayer. Fixed that!
[/list]

And there you have it! The next few months are going to be a lot of fun.
As always, let us know your thoughts in the comments!

Cheers,
Erik + team

notes.title: Patch Note: Final battle on Insane Difficulty!
notes.content:
Hello human!

We just launched a little patch (1.0.0.6) that makes the final Story Mode battle a little bit less unreasonable on Insane Difficulty! :)

Here is what it used to be like:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/87aceff2b1e479be5a5e477eb8724089eab31196.gif[/img]

Every time you died you would re-spawn as a spear1 unit.
With the patch, you will now re-spawn as whatever enemy type you entered the bridge with.

The Emperor is just as difficult. You still have no mind transfers available. But now you have a chance of entering the final battle as something other than what could arguably be called the weakest unit in the game! :D

To the 0.8% of players who managed the heroic feat of defeating the emperor as a spear1, well done! It is still possible to defeat the Emperor as a mark 1 robot. All you have to do is not die at all before reaching him! :)

A lot of you reached out to us expressing frustration with the previous difficulty, and we really appreciate all the feedback we've received from the launch so far, both good and bad!

Keep letting us know what you think of the game, as more bug fixes and adjustments will be coming!

Thanks for helping us make this a great launch!
/ Erik

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2545995788

As a bonus, [b]anyone who has won an Award or Honourable Mention can claim a code for FREE access to a Voxel Art video course![/b] It's by Zach Soares who worked on Clone Drone! To get your free code, message Josh on Discord, Steam or email josh@doborog.com

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/565a03b6aaaa97afb01e7951bb7590f74489c7cd.gif[/img]
[h2]Most Creative Mechanic[/h2]
[h3]Parkour by erworh[/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1762230045
The floor is lava! This is a really well made challenge because it's not too hard, and not too easy. The variety of ways the levels use jumping is fun!

[h2]Most Beautiful[/h2]
[h3]SpaceIncident - Save HiH by Meet_Met Me[/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2542836320

Creating a Space Station that looks so convincing and has so many hidden secrets is very impressive.

[h2]Best use of Animation[/h2]
[h3]The Last Launch by AROGOK[/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2547498330

There is a fully animated fight scene in this level! AROGOK used the camera to great effect and it even made me feel sad.

[h2]Best use of Vertical Space[/h2]

Look at the incredible art from !ShockDrive! Flattering the Community Managers by making their profile pictures in the game was a good way to end up on this list!

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2385812776
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2548497063
Fantorna and ALEX2014_16 have basically made brand new chapters of Story mode with cool animations, fights and drama! Great use of the voice lines!

We hope you enjoy playing and making levels on the workshop! We can't wait to see all the things you will make after launch!

Josh, Community Manager

notes.title: The LAUNCH Level Editor Competition is here!
notes.content:
Hello Humans!

We are announcing the Clone Drone in the Danger Zone Level Editor Competition!

Enter the competition for a chance to win an exclusive emote and the admiration of the whole community!

[h3]What is the theme of this competition?[/h3]
[h1]LAUNCH![/h1]

Because the game is coming out on July 27th, we thought this was appropriate.

[h1]Level Editor Competition Rules[/h1]

[h2]What kind of levels are allowed?[/h2]
The theme for the competition is Launch! That means anything to do with releasing Clone Drone, jumping, bouncing, spaceships blasting off, or whatever you can imagine is allowed.

The level MUST BE UPLOADED AS A CHALLENGE. We won’t play the level if you upload it as an Endless Mode level. notes.title: 0.19.2.41 - Preparation for Crossplay Support & Bugfixes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/33eecb88f6a02acff5ef99ed556aebd71f8a1412.gif[/img]
[i]Doborog Team explaining why console review is taking longer than expected
(thanks hoverfish2 for sharing this [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/CloneDrone/comments/mrcj7t/we_all_know_the_mark_3_skins_are_what_you_should/]meme template on Reddit r/CloneDrone[/url])[/i]

Helloooo humans!

We just released a teeny update on Steam! It includes some important preparation for our full console release to support crossplay 🤫

We also want to share an update on our console review progress to hopefully help answer the question... “why is there no release date yet, foolish indie game developing humans?!?”

[h1]Upgrades to Support Crossplay[/h1]

Let's start with something invisible! This release includes an update to our networking library that will allow us to support crossplay on consoles. That means you will be able to play with your friends, even if they’re on a different platform (which is inferior to [i]your[/i] favorite gaming platform, of course 😛).

[h1]Some More Bug Fixes![/h1]

While the server already kicks AFK players from co-op games, it will now kick them even if other players are playing while ignoring them. This will occur after 30 minutes of no input in public game servers, so stay active if you want to keep your endless streak going!

In exciting Not Crashing News™... after months of investigation, we solved a multiplayer crash that sometimes happened after joining games! Thanks to everyone who sent in descriptions of their crash scenarios to our bugs email. These are super helpful for our bugfixing!

[h1]Chapter 5 & console porting release update[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/9fe4a39a0cb96c2e6486cb05004ffaa0fec272f0.gif[/img]

While we heard from other devs that simultaneous releases with crossplay support are tough, we didn’t expect quite how long it would take! Rest assured we’re doing everything we can to get the game fully released on all the consoles as soon as we can. For example, when new bugs come in from the console platform reviewers, we drop everything, fix them, and submit a new build immediately. While the console review process takes longer than our usual Steam release cycle, and it can be frustrating for us too, we hope crossplay with our console friends will be well worth it!

For anyone interested, here's what the console process looks like: we prepare a build, then the console platform QA team tests and finds any issues. We then fix them and submit another build. Then they find fewer, smaller issues, we fix them, and when they finally don’t find any more issues... we can set a release date!

Review rounds have taken longer on some consoles because of reduced QA capacity during COVID. Given this, it’s been extra hard to predict exactly how long we’ve had left. Since the discovered issues are becoming fewer and lower-impact, we’re hopeful we’ll be able to lock down and announce a release date soon. That said, there’s no way for us to know exactly how many issues remain for them to find... and how many more review cycles it will take! We're crossing our fingers, and we will keep you all updated!

That’s it for this teeny bugfix update! We have some other fun things planned before launch, too, if you want to follow along:

[list]
[*] We have a TikTok that’s blowing up and we still don’t understand it: [url=https://tiktok.com/@doborog]https://tiktok.com/@doborog[/url]
[*] Erik’s streaming development live on Twitch almost every day: [url=https://twitch.tv/doborog]https://twitch.tv/doborog[/url]
[*] Discord’s poppin’: [url=https://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/discord]https://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/discord[/url]
[/list]

[i]Clean clean clean,[/i]
Brian & the Dobogang

notes.title: More bugfixes and a NERF!
notes.content:
Hello humans!

Are you looking forward to Chapter 5? Us too!

We're currently fixing the last bunch of bugs on consoles, and as soon as the console QA teams stop finding bugs (they are very good at it!) we will lock down a launch date and do a happy robot dance!

One upside of it taking slightly longer than expected is that we've had a lot of time to fix bugs in the Steam version of the game too! 

Here's what the latest little update includes:

[h1]Nerfed Infantry Command Bot![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/16c7e98bcbd06d003084eb71841e50bf7fd397c6.png[/img]
We looked at the data, and noticed that Infantry Command Bots are responsible for a looooot of lost clones in Endless Mode. One Diamond level in particular with only 3 Infantry Bots on average ate up 2.81 clones before being defeated!

So we made the following little changes:
[list]
[*] Reduced the max number of enemies spawned by a single Infantry Bot from 2 to 1.
[*] Made them not back up as much while doing the spawning.
[*] Removed the laser raptor from the higher difficulty spawn list.
[/list]
Let us know what you think of these changes!

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
We also fixed a lot of bugs! Here are the main ones:
[list]
[*] Invisible Enemies in Co-op! It turns out the Infantry Command Bot was responsible for this happening, so we decided to just remove the levels where they appear from co-op for now. They weren't in that many levels, so the slight loss of variety should hopefully not be felt too much.
[*] Kicking an Infantry Command Bot now kills the thing being spawned as opposed to having it hang around in a weird half-alive limbo state.
[*] Late game Co-op Disconnects: It turns out all co-op games shut down after precisely 2 hours. Whoops! They no longer do that.
[*] Crash bugs! We fixed some of the most frequent crash bugs.
[*] UseKeyTrigger no longer says "Jump to hyperspace!" instead of whatever you configure it to say in the Level Editor.
[*] Uranium/Insanium audio issues resolved: Previously music would cut out when too many things were happening at once. The game is now smarter about not playing things like footsteps halfway across the arena if 20 other sounds are already playing.
[/list]

That's it for this little update!

notes.title: Rules update: Teaming in public servers banned
notes.content:
Hello humans,

--- [b]A quick summary of this post[/b] -----------------------------------------------

- [b]Teaming is not allowed[/b] on [i]any[/i] [u]public[/u] server (teaming on private servers is still fine!)

- From now on, possible consequences for teaming include: [b]temporary/permanent bans, win count resets[/b]

- [b]Reporting[/b] can be done via the in-game reporting, sending a Discord DM to Carissa or Josh, or emailing us at support@doborog.com. If you see it, let us know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/7f79108548a3e2e9d32fa5e15e85057ec119ec85.png[/img]

There have been a lot of reports of teaming in public Last Bot Standing matches, and we have decided to officially say: [b]teaming is banned on [i]any[/i] public servers[/b]. Reminder that teaming in private servers is still allowed, as long as all players in the private server agree to it!

--- [b]What is teaming?[/b]-----------------------------------------------

Teaming is when two or more players join the same match, and agree to avoid targeting each other for any length of time (examples: the entire game, until the final area, until a certain number of players remain, etc.). Sometimes (but not always), players who are teaming will fight other players together. Teaming can happen to give these players upgrades and wins, and is unfair to everyone joining the game solo.

Any situation where players attempt to give a win to a specific person is considered teaming, regardless of how many players are involved or what public server they're on. It's against the rules to team in any public servers even if all players in that LBS match agree to team.

--- [b]Some examples of teaming[/b] -------
- Talking to other players--sometimes in-game (using emotes or other methods), or more often, outside the game (using voice chat, messages on Discord/Steam, etc.)--to create alliances or work together on some larger goal. (As a warning: going forward, using teaming as a method of combating someone else’s teaming may put you at risk. We do try to take into account players’s motivations when handing out consequences, but it is not always possible to do so 100% accurately)

--- [b]Some examples of [i][u]not[/u][/i] teaming[/b] -------
- Coincidentally all targeting the same person for a limited amount of time because they're the biggest threat (reasons for this include: they have the highest skill level, they have a really powerful upgrade (like giant mode), etc.)

- Running away from/not fighting someone because they're scary and you want to live lol


*Note that these examples are only a couple of common scenarios, and don’t include all possible scenarios.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We know it can be discouraging as a new player to see how skilled our veteran players are, and how high their wincounts are because of that. We’ve seen teaming used as a means of improving a new player’s experience. While we are still banning teaming in public servers, we see the need for more support for new players, and we’re currently doing some research into that. (As always, we strongly welcome community ideas and feedback!)

For our players who found the team gameplay aspect of teaming fun (especially our organized clans!), we’d love for you to reach out and let us know how we can support you in other ways. Things like organized private server teaming battles can be a lot of fun!
 
--- [b]Next steps[/b] -----------------------------------------------

There won't be any action taken against people who have used teaming before now because it wasn't an official rule. After this point however, we will begin investigating any teaming reports we receive. If, after investigation by our team, someone is determined to be teaming, consequences will be applied (including temporary/permanent bans and win count resets).

Good luck in the arena,
Josh and Carissa

notes.title: Update 19 - Spear & Shield Refresh, Japanese & Korean, Updated Next Chapter Date
notes.content:
[i]Happy October[/i]! Doborog has been heads down hard at work on the epic final Story Mode chapter—see update on timing of that below—but we're taking a pit-stop to put out an update of some improvements we wanted to get out ASAP!

[h1]🛡 Spear and Shield Overhaul![/h1]

In response to feedback, we've decided to refresh the Spear and Shield mechanics! Many didn't like combat with the spear—to the point it was banned from fan tournaments due to flicking. We hope this update helps these weapons become a fun part of competitive play once again.

[list]
[*] [b]The Spear[/b] damage area (the part that destroys voxels) has been changed to wide instead of long, making the spear more effective when it travels forward, and worse when it travels sideways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/7d78cd1cac76ee9908c931c2a698c64c8f5d4fa8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/9ad19153359a856adefada7aab69956b0c44c592.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Spear flicking[/b] was still possible in multiplayer, so we have restricted it even more. Let us know how it feels!
[*] [b]The Shield[/b] is now breakable! That's right. The shield no longer protects you forever, but takes damage whenever a weapon hits it. This makes combat more interesting, and opens up for strategies that are less about going around the shield, and more about whittling it down to get past it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/91ac2dc1dd715991b587f462318d47a9e8b0f564.gif[/img]

[/list]

[h1]🌏 Japanese (日本語) and Korean (한국어)![/h1]

Yes! More human languages for the communication bank. The robots now support Japanese and Korean subtitles.

Beautiful!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/327fc6299245b5c1288774ddcc1a631b097243d2.gif[/img]

Like with the other languages, we would love to hear your feedback to improve the quality of the translations. Let us know if something doesn't feel quite [i]qilsnib[/i] enough.

[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]

[h2]Better Crosshair for Spear and Bow[/h2]

The crosshair on the bow and spear could previously be hard to see depending on the situation. The bow and spear now have a new crosshair that's bigger and inverts the colors behind it for maximum contrast. Let us know how it feels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/8080aa250c8dcd44d9b8aacdca3418053c36e9d0.gif[/img]

[h2]Arrow Rotation now SNAPS[/h2]
Arrow rotation now snaps instantly between vertical and horizontal mode, giving you unprecedented tactical control for how you deal damage. Hotshot Arrow-Shooting Tip: Spidertrons mainly bob up and down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/1c6e61ee9b4b551ca8c878a9bc28bcb298865fc7.gif[/img]

[h2]Head Damage: Not always fatal![/h2]

Has THIS ever happened to YOU: 3 decorative voxels get taken off the beautiful horn attachment of your robot head, and you fall down on the ground, dead as the day you were harvested?

Now head damage is only fatal if it damages the important cubes sitting near where your central processing unit resides (a 2x2 cube 3 voxels above the neck).

[h2]Helping Stationary Bow1s Un-stick in Twitch Mode[/h2]

In Twitch Mode bow1s now walk towards you if they're the last type of enemy in the level, which should cause fewer issues with them landing on pillars and taunting your inability to destroy them.

[h2]Fix for Armor Exploit in Last Bot Standing[/h2]

It used to be possible to acquire armor in LBS, leave and re-join the match, and continue to have that armor for zero upgrade points. No longer!

[h1]Chapter 5 - New Release Date[/h1]

We are still hard at work on Chapter 5, and we're now aiming to release it early next year.

Why the delay? A few reasons combined made it a choice we hope you can appreciate:

[list]
[*] [b]Scope/Quality/Time balance[/b] - As some say, pick two 😅.  While we could have rushed the final chapter update out sooner, we felt that adding a bit of time lets us get closer to the updates the game deserves for its exit out of Early Access. This includes the quality of life changes in this update, and epic-ness of Chapter 5 :)
[*] [b]Making a big splash with full release[/b] - We are planning a big push to share the game more widely with the full release, and (you might have noticed) the end of this year is packed with the releases of new games and consoles. We want to harvest and upload the minds of as many humans as possible into the arena at release, and we've learned choosing the date wisely is part of that. We will announce more about the release here at a later time, too!
[*] [b]Console requirements[/b] - We are planning to launch on (at least) 3 different consoles! Parallel to Chapter 5, our porting team has been working tirelessly towards making sure the game has the features required by consoles.
[/list]

As always, for those of you who live on the bleeding edge, you can [url=https://www.twitch.tv/doborog]follow our development live on Twitch[/url], and even try out the current (very buggy!) build in the experimental branch. While we know how it can be disappointing to have release dates slip, we hope you all can appreciate where we’re landing!

Thank you all for being amazing OG Clone Drone community members! We are so glad to have those of you who have stuck with us throughout the long development process with us during launch and beyond. 💙

notes.title: Last Bot Standing: New levels + Balancing!
notes.content:
Hello humans!

Good news! We just added 5 new delightful Last Bot Standing levels, and introduced several balancing changes.

[h1]Weapon Balancing[/h1]
Have you ever observed other players spinning around crazily and somehow killing people?
We have, and it's not much fun to be on the other side of. 

The new update introduces restrictions on how far you can turn while swinging your weapon.
Our goal has been to maintain a good range of motion, so you can still rotate towards your target and strike with great precision, but discourage flailing around wildly around in an attempt to make the hitbox make accidental contact with your opponent.

All weapons have this new restriction, but the one where it was used the most was probably the spear.

To illustrate what we're talking about, here is a demonstration of flicking the spear around:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/bf2f724698fcc9cbc47e979b0c90ebd3681573cf.gif[/img]
(thanks Gontarekt + Niek Alexander!)

And here is the fix:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/642b4780a33f4096c551f33a944ee2322973d2b1.gif[/img]
The camera still moves to not interrupt your flow of motion.

The spear is of course not the only weapon this applies to. Hammer + Sword can no longer spin around wildly either.

Other multiplayer balancing changes:[list][*] Sword attack cooldown increased from 0.6s to 0.7s to make it slightly less easy to spam attacks.
[*] Raptor kick cooldown increased to 2s, leaving a small opening for attack in between kicks.
[*] Kick + Dash: Kicking in the middle of a Dash no longer cancels the Dash momentum
[/list]

A final note: We don't resent anyone who may have flicked their spear around or rotated their hammer wildly in the past. If the game allows you to do it, it is a legitimate way to play! It is our hope that these changes make for a more predictable and fun multiplayer experience for everyone. Let us know what you think! :)

[h1]New levels![/h1]Five new levels has entered the permanent Last Bot Standing rotation!

[h3]Moving Floor[/h3]The risk/reward of getting upgrades is turned TO THE MAX in this level where the floor goes away when you stand on it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/a6aed9d92c9a8aac253374782ed2512334ea7ec6.gif[/img]

[h3]The Facility[/h3]Jump around these pretty walkways.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/4459adf51c9f977e901ea9f12ee68b4a1c4a69f3.png[/img]

[h3]Death Cubes[/h3]What is better than a Death Cube? ALL THE DEATH CUBES!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/5450325a3e3104bf88f7209d16a49d19ce17669b.png[/img]

[h3]Cliffside[/h3]Vast height differences and moving platforms makes for an interesting time among the cliffs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/9b327c012d16c79372d1e818e443f01132ba5ea8.png[/img]

[h3]Crashed Waiting Room[/h3]Do you like playing in the Waiting Room? Now you don't have to leave it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/c02fbe43afd1ef2aff3a2908a1f91af807ca422b.png[/img]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
You can now push garbage around.
Help the garbage bots keep the arena clean! 🚮🚮🚮
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/a5f8017514d86c7a1d05a1a5ac6849f00f5817eb.gif[/img]

We've also fixed a multitude of bugs, including:
[list][*] Armor was completely not working against the hammer in co-op!
[*] Hammer bots can no longer kill you while returning the hammer to the idle position
[*] Numerous crash bugs!
[*] Many minor localization updates based on your excellent feedback. Thanks everyone for your reports!
[/list] 

[h1]Now what??[/h1]The time has come... for CHAPTER 5!!!

We'll be ramping up development for the final story chapter in the coming weeks.
This is going to be an epic chapter, so expect a release date many months from now.

More info when we have it! :)

notes.title: Update 16 - Achievements, Emotes, Skins, Co-op Challenges!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qluG68Xtovo
It's here!

Update 16 adds the following awesome things:
[list]
[*][b]Achievements![/b]
[*][b]Emotes![/b]
[*][b]Skins![/b]
[*][b]Co-op Challenges![/b]
[*][b]A variety of Co-op focused improvements![/b]
[/list]

Let's break it down!


[h1]Achievements[/h1]
We've added 43 new achievements!
They are a mix of delightful small things like kicking a kickbot, to major accomplishments like defeating Story Mode on Insane Difficulty.

Each new achievement unlocks either a robot Skin or an Emote, letting you enhance your multiplayer presence in delightful ways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/aa56ca6ac9038f154ae1976b17055549182e08cc.png[/img]

You can see a list of all achievements here: https://steamcommunity.com/stats/597170/achievements


[h1]Emotes[/h1]
Ever since we added multiplayer we've received requests for being able to communicate with your fellow players. Emotes is the answer.

With a default set letting you say Hello, Goodbye, Where is the Water? etc you can let your fellow humans know you see them right away.

The real fun begins once you unlock the ones hidden behind the new Achievements. Flap your arms like a bird, or dance delightfully across the arena floor on your way to victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/310dc12ed7773fea810a729d81f6b83f4650d5dc.gif[/img]


[h1]Skins[/h1]
No, not human skins! Why would you THINK THAT??

Unlock a variety of cool robot models that you can customize by selecting your favorite color. By the power of voxel technology, all the game's robots are given new life along with a new color scheme.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/5372e97797d1de2ebba04d393f1e04475be3f8cd.png[/img]


[h1]Co-op Challenges![/h1]
Now you have even more ways to co-operate with your fellow humans. Tackle one of the game's many Challenges together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/2858f0df8458f10e4ae58147c356bcf2713e2168.png[/img]

We've also added a brand new Co-op exclusive challenge in the form of the One Weapon Challenge, where each human must specialize in only one weapon.


[h1]Various game improvements![/h1]
In addition to all of the above we've added:
[list]
[*] More upgrades bots for co-op matches!
[*] An AFK timer that automatically teleports slow moving players to the elevator.
[*] Quick Join buttons that check all game modes to quickly find a match where players are needed.
[*] Overhauled the settings menu to finally use tabs.
[*] All swords now glow with the favorite color of your robot!
[*] Improved spear collisions at close distances.
[*] Increased the cost of Spear and Shield in Last Bot Standing to 2 points each.
[*] Removed public matchmaking from Duels. With a finite amount of players and the addition of co-op challenges we decided it was time to remove it in order to emphasize the other game modes. Private Duels still work.

This was a massive update, and we want to thank everyone who played the beta and gave feedback and support along the way!

Do you have thoughts on the new features and changes? Let us know in the comments! :D

notes.title: Progress Update: New Upgrade Room, Uranium/Insanium tiers, and Endless Levels!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/caabb3cd10326a0545d117a6c0ebf001a482121b.png[/img]

We're baaaaaaaaaack! We've been working on some awesome stuff the last few weeks, so figured it's high time for an update post!

[h1]New Upgrade Room![/h1]

Following up on the new Arena design detailed in [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/2019/07/02/progress-update-co-op-new-arena-spider-tron-and-twitch-mode/]our last preview[/url], the upgrade room and spawn areas are being given face-lifts of their own.

Can you spot the difference?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/ff7fb90cdc3bf308ebfcfcb94d15e75810b1d138.gif[/img]

The TVs now also show a preview of the next level!

[h1]New Difficulty Tiers: Uranium and Insanium![/h1]

Clone Drone is "TOO EASY", you say? Well, now you've done it. We're adding two new difficulty tiers: [b]Uranium[/b] and [b]Insanium[/b]. Good luck.

[h1]Fresh Level Layouts![/h1]

As part of the all-new Arena design detailed in [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/2019/07/02/progress-update-co-op-new-arena-spider-tron-and-twitch-mode/]our last preview[/url], we're working through all of the existing endless levels and enhancing them with the power of awesome new art and the last two year's worth of level editor improvements.

[h1]Before & After:[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/b71452d67bb0f158b49a84943121f1343298a504.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/69ef2fe31587b08be5081b104b4285b260aef672.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/711341286156920ad6ac2a5d3f3556c981667b2f.gif[/img]

[h1]Twitch Extension Beta, sign up to help test it out![/h1]

We'll be including a Twitch Extension update alongside the next update, and will be starting a beta test of the extension before then. [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/contact-us/]Shoot us an email[/url] with your Twitch stream URL and we will send along a link to the experimental beta extension once it's approved for testing by Twitch (late this week or early next week, hopefully!).

The updated Twitch Extension will feature:
[list]
 	[*]a new Enemy Spawn Queue in the extension will let viewers see exactly which enemies will be spawned next and their current position in line. No more trying to time your spawns for the next round or "maximum enemies have been spawned this round!" warnings![/*]
 	[*]for Twitch Affiliate/Partner players, you can now use Bits from the extension to cheer for the streamer on top of your enemies. There will also be an optional "Bits-Only Mode" for large streams[/*]
 	[*]Level Editor: new ability to mark your Endless levels as "Twitch-only" or "Exclude from Twitch". (These won't require re-beating the level, so will be easier to toggle on and off)[/*]
 	[*]Level Editor: new TwitchSpawnPoint objects that allow for more viewer spawns per round and configuration of where different types of viewer enemies should be spawned[/*]
 	[*]instead of just some enemies being viewer-driven, ALL enemies will be dynamically spawned by the audience. If not enough viewer spawns are available, the game will automatically spawn enemies for you.[/*]
[/list]

These features are still under heavy development, and during the beta will require using a separate test Twitch Extension app, so wait for the extension beta instructions if you'd like to try it early!

[h1]Don't forget, Co-op is coming this next release![/h1]

We've been having a blast playing co-op, and these arena and level changes have been making it all the more fun.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/745b776284c38a66aa109f507e999a51b8d7d5e2.png[/img]

As always, Doborog is streaming development live on Twitch! [url=https://twitch.tv/doborog]https://twitch.tv/doborog[/url]

As we noted last time, on the stream page you can also find a link to access the latest experimental builds, which include progress on co-op and the new arena. (As the description notes — these builds are under heavy development and will contain lots of bugs! So proceed with caution :D)

We are aiming to release the co-op update before the end of August. It's going to be a big update!

Until then!!

notes.title: Progress Update: Co-op, New Arena, Spider-tron and Twitch mode!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/21f77fe220731069828ea70564d4dc9ebc32681d.gif[/img]

Happpppy Summerrrr! We've been hard at work on some fun new things for our next major update, so we figured now would be a good time to share some peeks at what's in store.

[h1]Co-op Endless Mode![/h1]

Co-op has been one of our most requested features since we added multiplayer support last year. Now that we've started building it, we get it -- it's really fun! For the past few weeks we've been working through the various parts of endless mode to make them multiplayer co-op compatible.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/ab4dcaac6bdbba65ea65294e6b89fcb8c7bd4aee.gif[/img]

Co-op places you and a partner in the arena for some tag-team robot slicing. Clones are shared, and if you run out, your partner's last-ditch combat may be the only thing standing between glory and humiliating defeat.

Our initial "tests" are revealing Co-op is a great mode to play with a friend and jam on for a few hours. Yes... "tests"... (we may have become a bit addicted...)

[h1]Arena Makeover![/h1]

Gary has been applying his voxel skills to refresh the Arena!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/40f65034ab1b88454681b014335b0486c3fdd080.jpg[/img]

Ooh... pretty!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/ca80def6f9f0f79a9b9b3069f8084d7c2e44de19.jpg[/img]

The audience! What is this?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/07fe03db4b37bfe89949fa8f8034044f73831fb5.gif[/img]

They're doing the SIN() wave!

[h1]Spider-tron Legs![/h1]

As part of upgrading spiders-tron to work well in multiplayer for Co-op, we're making their legs smarter! Gone are the days of spider-tron falling over at the slightest gust of wind.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/7e6fcef27c448750c25f7404cc0d20a740a1e981.gif[/img]

What wonderful inverse kinematics!

[h1]Twitch Mode Update![/h1]

We <3 Twitch mode! It's been a while since our last major Twitch-related update, so this update we will be doing a refresh of Twitch mode and the Twitch Extension. If there's something you'd like to see in Twitch mode, now's a great time to let us know, too!

If you're a Twitch streamer and interested in trying out betas of the extension update, [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/contact-us/]email us[/url] with your Twitch stream URL and we will get you hooked up to try the latest!

[h1]Streams and Experimental Branch[/h1]

Did you know?! Doborog has been streaming co-op development daily! If you would like to follow along with the latest, check out the Twitch stream here: [url=https://twitch.tv/doborog]https://twitch.tv/doborog[/url]

On the stream page you can also find a link to access the latest experimental builds, which include progress on co-op and the new arena. (As the description notes -- these builds are under heavy development and will contain lots of bugs! So proceed with caution :D)

We're expecting to ship this update some time in August, and will share more on release as it's closer to complete.

Until next time!

notes.title: 0.14.1 – Spears Everywhere!! & Death Cube 3.0
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/85b95b2c39bb3e6cdfc9d892c63db479f479462f.png[/img]

Holy cow, Chapter 4 was a big update!

Between the new enemies, mind transfer mechanic and spear / shield, we decided to put together a quick mini-release to add these elements throughout the game. (We also took this as an opportunity to do some extra bug fixing and optimization!)

[h1]Spears in Multiplayer & Last Bot Standing![/h1]

Spears and shields... over the network?!?! Yes!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/26f3aaa4e5a955d9e6fb2520f073065a978fd9b9.png[/img]

The basic spear costs 1 upgrade point, which introduces many opportunities for interesting spear-combination builds.

All out of upgrade points? There is now also a Max Spear drop in Last Bot Standing!

[h1]New endless levels!! ...and Death Cube 3.0[/h1]

This update adds a fresh batch of endless levels that feature the new enemies introduced in chapter 4. You'll find these levels are chock-full of spear and fleet command / analysis bots.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/7257ad47d4e5e564f347630462a3ef6dee6da78d.gif[/img]

Look for these levels in Endless and Twitch modes (and in the workshop challenge below). Keep your head down!

[h1]Spears on Twitch![/h1]

We released an updated Twitch extension (0.0.7) with the new enemies from chapter 4.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/29601cf54494aa0d517fa4baa59c035da088bea1.png[/img]

We also:

[list]
 	[*]Updated the Twitch extension's "Allow Access" hint to reflect Twitch's new layout[/*]
 	[*]Updated the "Configuration" page with extra helpful getting started steps and support for Dark Mode[/*]
 	[*]Enabled spawning kick bots on flame raptors from the extension, since we hear it is "the ultimate troll move"[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Optimized lava![/h1]

No longer must you fear lava causing the game to grind to a jittery halt! (Now you can fear it just because it might set you on fire...)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/6023dc170fe801b43e5761eb44b8fdc8a798e7fc.png[/img]

[h1]Less Garbage Setting![/h1]

Not a fan of garbage? There is now a setting to limit the amount of robot garbage the game keeps around the level. This is especially useful for Twitch Mode, or other custom levels with tons of enemies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/4e66b2cace1bd7542f29360bd841627c9fd6e4ab.png[/img]

[h1]Loading bars for Chapters 3 & 4!![/h1]

We decided Chapters 3 and 4 are levels so big, they deserve their own dedicated loading bars. Now you can cheer on your computer while the bar fills up!

[h1]Challenge Modifiers: Random Upgrades & Mind Transfers, & more![/h1]

You can now enable any of the following in your workshop challenges:

[list]
 	[*]Mind Transfer mode[/*]
 	[*]Random Upgrade mode[/*]
 	[*]Greatswords for all[/*]
 	[*]Armor for all[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/6ebb97d7ea2bfb033585bcb683fdf767633a0d52.png[/img]

Set these in the Level Editor under Challenges -> Config! We are looking forward to seeing what folks make with these new modifiers!

[h1]Bonus: Random Upgrade Challenge 2.0![/h1]

To demonstrate the Random Upgrade modifier for Workshop Challenges, Doborog put together a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1750490893][b]Random Upgrade Challenge 2.0[/b][/url] workshop challenge that features new endless mode maps from this update (including Death Cube 3.0)!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/e20a883ae3f08ee08eddc4ddbff017101d2ea87f.png[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1750490893]Subscribe on the Steam Workshop[/url] and play the challenge it under Challenges -> Workshop!

We hope you enjoy this update, & up next: Co-op!!

notes.title: 0.14.0 – Chapter 4 has landed!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/bcca184408aa5ed0f98a280440e24d477c581aeb.gif[/img]

Wait no longer, Chapter 4 has arrived!

[h1]Story Mode Continues[/h1]

With your mind now transferred into the Fleet, make your way through one of the fleet's most heavily armed ships.

[h1]So many new things![/h1]

[h1]Mind Transfer![/h1]

With no Clones or business transfer stations in the Fleet, you're going to need a backup plan. Mind Transfer gives you a lifeline and opportunity to fight as a variety of enemies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/403f049ba1ff226fcbe99c3826161d8150e7c699.gif[/img]

[h1]Spear and Shield![/h1]

Stab enemies in the face with the new laser spear! The spear rewards precisely aimed stabs, and just feels dang satisfying.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/d9d9d91f78456244276159849feaf7c726a63fa0.gif[/img]

Spears are now available as an upgrade in endless mode, the Spear Only challenge (which unlocks the Flame Spear), and in a number of enemies you can transfer in to in Chapter 4.

[h1]Zero Gravity Combat![/h1]

Grab your gravity boots, we're going outside! Chapter 4 features zero gravity combat, which makes for beautiful floating bouquets of voxel destruction.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/b7fbc64a56cc25c8f743fe7c595a93c91a0a927c.gif[/img]

[h1]Awesome Animations![/h1]

One of the major innovations in the development of Chapter 4 is the addition of a Level Editor Animation System. This is also available for use by level editors! Check out this [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BDS__k5Shv8]demo video with some more details on how to use it![/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/e6c75052b212aa28a512d31038028c13829bd0bd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Amazing new art! Spaceships! Gary![/h1]

This chapter is our first since the talented Gary Lucken joined the team! Gary's incredible voxel art is featured heavily throughout chapter 4.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/deccd4b3e6629af9bc6de43cc7b005b71eaf0589.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/dbe7ad7662971d49e011f76ed0ed6e69535330e6.jpg[/img]

Pretty!

[h1]Robot Enemies that SAY STUFF![/h1]

Look who's talking too! Combat robots in Chapter 4 feature a primitive voice system that allows for dynamic commentary. (This is also now available for use in the level editor!)

[h1]New Enemies & Epic Boss-fight[/h1]

Chapter 4 features a number of new enemies, culminating in an epic battle with some fresh new faces. Good luck!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/4d28e4b8555997e733caf272d57b062785d50f8b.gif[/img]

[h1]New Challenges: Spear-Only & Mind Transfer[/h1]

In the Mind Transfer challenge, death is only the beginning. Can you make it to Titanium armed only with the ability to transfer your mind into enemies??

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/ff201f83846813266768f4a31cd1d22fa356436e.png[/img]

The Spear-Only Challenge puts your spear skills to the test. Beating it unlocks the [b]flame spear[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/deb1f399b010a739a64745cdc826519fb046e7b7.png[/img]

[h1]Today: Bug Fixes! Later: Mini-Update![/h1]

Today we've already released some bug hotfixes, but if you encounter anything / get stuck in the game and can't continue let us know in the [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/discord]community Discord[/url] or at [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/contact-us/]our support email[/url].

Next up we are going to put out a mini-release integrating some of these sweet new features elsewhere in the game (like adding the spear to multiplayer!)

Have fun!

notes.title: 0.13.2 – Controller Support & Key Remapping now LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/70cabba2d90a9ab2f6ea43028bb2b3d7503e2bfe.gif[/img]

Just about two years ago when we first started on Early Access, we included these two puppies on our FAQ:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/a93ef313faeab8c853dc5ee124a3ac87e8ac67c3.png[/img]

Turns out, [u]eventually[/u] is [u]NOW[/u]!

[h1]Controller Support!![/h1]

Clone Drone now supports a wide variety of game controllers! You may now lean back and bask in the glory of playing Clone Drone in the comfort of not-with-your-keyboard-and-mouse.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/39db9688b99fb45216ad7f59c8795a203be932ea.gif[/img]

The game's UI buttons are fully navigable by your controller's left stick or D-pad, and they come with visual selection and sound effects to make it clearer which button is selected.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/e7c9ba1b6b5d5cd2ab009f54ec8dcab499c3c351.gif[/img]

Pretty!

Controller hints throughout the game have also been updated to use icons for the specific controller you are using. It will even swap hints in real-time if you change controllers or move back to using mouse and keyboard:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/e07935ed70ccb84f46a9b93faa79174bbb9f6107.gif[/img]

Thanks to everyone who helped test the controller support while it was in its infancy (shout-outs to [u]Myriad453, AwesomePants, GeekCrafter412, Stealth000[/u], [u]Arcylic, davy jones locker, JustASloth, Jelley, theyummyoyster, RedCreep, X606, Dat Alpha Waffle, Niek_Alexander, LagTeam Leader [/u]& everyone from the Discord #controller-testers channel!). This rag-tag crew of brave experimental branch testers was super helpful in tuning the default set of buttons to something that was not just usable, but some may even say preferred!

Let us know what you think! And if you try it out with an esoteric flight pedal or Guitar Hero controller, send us a clip, because that's just awesome.

[h1]Key Remapping and Customization[/h1]

Dvorak, Colemak, and AZERTY friends! No longer must you suffer the indignation of switching keyboard layouts or using external utilities prior to becoming a sword robot.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/8d3f9ea483f32f81064888b6500e8de9aa6d7e8d.png[/img]

With the new Edit Controls menu, you may now remap in-game actions to whatever key (or controller button/axis) you would like. Let us know if there are any actions you would like to see made configurable in this menu!

[h1]BONUS! Another quick Chapter 4 Sneak Peek...[/h1]

While Brian was working on getting controller support and key remapping hooked up, Erik has continued adding mind-blowing new mechanics that will be featured in chapter 4, like [u]low gravity combat:[/u]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/41dcde3db5a31e2be31d7ae93c550c6bef4038d2.gif[/img]

We're anticipating launching Chapter 4 and some new bonus challenges towards the end of April, if all goes to plan.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/7037e8b113c175cd19ea59c0b75b220f616b074a.png[/img]

Until next time!

notes.title: More Chapter 4 Sneak Peeks, & coming soon: Controller Support, Key Remapping
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/ca4cde7b0673940cb39f0c10ea59c327e429a7ae.png[/img]

We figured it's about time for another UPDATE POOOOST!

We've been hard at work constructing a mind-bending Story Mode Chapter 4 with completely new weapons, environment art, interactive story animations and characters. If you thought Chapter 3's journey outside of the arena was a step up from the first chapters, wait 'til you experience this next chapter :D

[b]We are expecting Chapter 4 to release some time in April[/b], and we will follow up with more details as we are closer to wrapping up its development.

Controller support (yes, controller support!) should come out some time in the next couple of weeks. See below for more details!

[h1]Chapter 4 Sneak Peeks (Spoiler Alert!)[/h1]

Check out these tubes! Erik has been taking the level editor's [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/2019/01/30/preview-animation-system-mind-transfers/]new in-editor animation system[/url] and using it to bring Chapter 4 to another level. Watch for even more immersive, surprising moments during this chapter.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/613e664a2a5effd2ba33a7f6d088373bd541f537.gif[/img]

One request we've gotten from players since we started in Early Access has been to [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BRWvfMLl4ho]tighten up the graphics[/url] a bit. With the incredible [url=http://www.armyoftrolls.co.uk/]Gary Lucken[/url] now part of the Doborog crew, Chapter 4 is bringing the game's visuals to another level!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/9d4d1b78841959950544b13d75a8b1489ec6c5d1.gif[/img]

Another feature of the new level editor animation system added for chapter 4 is the ability to animate LIGHTS!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/fe4a8b2b076a07e68e1f60669e3c06aecf15fad8.gif[/img]

Pretty!

[h1]Controller Support: Coming Soon![/h1]

[i](Even before Chapter 4!)[/i]

One of the top requests we've gotten ever since we entered Early Access has been support for game controllers & key remapping.

As fans of playing games with controllers on the PC ourselves, we always suspected Clone Drone would be a great fit for controller support, but couldn't be sure until we tested it out to confirm. (That's why we were always careful not to [i]promise[/i] controller support, in case it didn't fit with the gameplay!)

Turns out, it works, and it feels great! (Some may say it's even better than keyboard and mouse. But those people would be heretics.)

Here's VastLite slaying at the game while twiddling his thumbs:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/6104c3563f79bec535ae7f2b31aa1e5cf3952b93.gif[/img]

[h1]Bonus: Control Scheme / Key Remapping![/h1]

No QWERTY? No problem! One of the things we're adding in the process of adding controller support is the ability to re-map in-game actions to whatever keys or mouse buttons you'd like.

Dvorak, AZERTY, and non-US keyboard users, rejoice!

[i](Now we haven't tried it with a Guitar Hero controller yet... but we can't say that it WOULDN'T work...)[/i]

[h1]Want to help try Controller Support + Key Remapping Early?[/h1]

We’re working with some early testers to whittle down a default control set that feels great across the gamut of controllers out there.

For those interested in trying the controller support + key remapping development pre-alpha early, join the [b]#controller-testers[/b] room on [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/discord]the community-run Discord[/url] and we'll put instructions there on how to test the controller support branch out. We'd love to hear what controls you find the most intuitive / enjoyable as you play.

[i]Note: the controller branch is still under heavy development and not quite feature-complete, so it may change / break your game data, so be sure to back your save data up before trying it out![/i]

[h1]Thanks and <3[/h1]

For long-requested, larger features like this, it's taken a bit longer between updates than we'd otherwise prefer. Turns out -- constructing a mind-blowing chapter with all-new enemies, environments, animation system, weapons, etc, takes a single developer while! & so does re-vamping the game's input system and UI navigation to support a variety of controllers. :)

Rest assured, we're well on the way to concluding the game's epic tale and rounding out the rest of our planned major features for the game!

To all of you who have been with us in Early Access, diligently trying updates as we've continued developing the game -- who continued streaming, sending in bugs, moderating community spaces, creating incredible workshop maps and blowing our minds with what's possible with the tools we manage to share -- thank you!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/ee32da5a4519fc5debbc707116264b61140940b1.gif[/img]

Stay awesome, and watch for updates here soon!

notes.title: Ho ho ho! New levels from the Workshop in LBS!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/745093e3859e1ea7b47351e63c090442477a8044.jpg[/img]

This past weekend we held another Last Bot Standing playtest, it was a lot of fun! Thanks everyone who came to the stream to play test the levels.

In the spirit of the season, we've added FOUR new maps to the Last Bot Standing rotation today, and may add one more over the holidays pending a couple of small level tweaks.

We mentioned for last playtest that our level themes are just suggestions to inspire those who don't have an idea to start with, so you'll see non-METAL-CHRISTMAS-themed maps sprinkled in we think you will still enjoy! So if you have an idea for our next Last Bot Standing playtest, no need to wait for the next theme, you can start building now!

[h1]New levels live now![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/96e3f3c07c1c13828cff28868ac886802cc2c383.jpg[/img]

Ho-ho-ho-ly mother of Christmas decorations! Lots of nice Christmas touches throughout this map. Grab a gift from on top of one of the gifts. The combat area is cozier than most maps, so watch your back!

[h1]Ho! Ho! Ho-norable Mentions[/h1]

There were a bunch of other fun METAL CHRISTMAS-themed levels we had fun playing on Saturday! These levels were very close to being included as well, and deserve to be mentioned:
[list]
 	[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1589408784]Santa's Lair[/url] by Sir Kotok - awesome Christmas decoration![/*]
 	[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1585361669]DannyBot & Clones Salvaging Co.[/url] by fencing_vogel - featuring some mega compound-traps that are really fun to destroy your robot body with[/*]

[/list]

[h1]Next Playtest: in a month, theme TBD![/h1]

These playtest events have been a ton of fun, so we're gonna keep doing them! Some have asked that we give a bit more time between playtests, so we'll be doing the next one in about a month. We'll announce the next theme in an upcoming blog post, so watch for it!

[h1]What's next: Chapter 4, Controller Support, and Multiplayer Regions![/h1]

If you missed our [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/2018/12/14/chapter-4-sneak-peek-spear-bots-and-battlecruisers/]last update post[/url], [b]Erik[/b] has been building a brand new weapon and enemy for Story Mode Chapter 4. Watch for another post in the not too distant future on a neat level editing tool he's adding to make the chapter even more dynamic than the others.

[b]Brian[/b]'s been adding controller support to the game and UI, and some say it might feel even better than playing with a mouse + keyboard (sacrilege!). That will be shipped alongside a change to our multiplayer system to support more regions to hopefully improve pings for those of you in US-West and possibly other regions.

Watch for our next update, and have a very happy holidays & new year! <3

notes.title: Chapter 4 Sneak Peek - Spear Bots and Battlecruisers!
notes.content:
We're currently hard at work on Chapter 4!
Here's a little peek at where things are at. :)

[h1]The Spear![/h1]
The game gets its third melee weapon: The Spear!

Paired with a shield, it focuses on precise stabs with a solid defensive barrier.
Here is what happens if you put it in the hands of some high level enemy bots:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RYwTMUqXEcc

Note: All spear, shield and enemy models are temporary placeholders.

[h1]Battlecruiser art exploration![/h1]
Gary has been exploring what the hallways of the robot Battlecruiser might look like!

Below are some high definition mockups that will likely mutate and change as we figure out how to break them down into reusable level elements:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/f5cd0db40d0fe34f88aca10e71f6875ec5ff0191.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/c389077407133e6a8468cd7fb856fcb983b32aee.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/ef9897e231c78ab4d33859f834327a22266ec210.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/55a835c3165a40359692eeb6eb6a05f21c8f1cf7.png[/img]

Chapter 4 is going to be pretty. :D

[h1]What's next??[/h1]
Most of the work still lies ahead of us. We're still in the planning and exploration stages, but we'll likely move on to level design in January and start putting the chapter together!

It's too early to tell exactly when this thing launches, but we're aiming for sometime around February / March.

In the mean time, join us tomorrow as we play test Metal Christmas levels from the workshop. And watch for a mini-update in the next couple of weeks related to controller support and server regions!

[h1]Last Bot Standing Workshop levels![/h1]

Some of you were asking if you could make and play your own Last Bot Standing multiplayer levels. Now you can!!

With a single click, your work in progress level is on a dedicated multiplayer server and ready to play-test. We now wish this was in every game's level editor!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/27b4bfcd3434e887eea626b0f50c5cd97ea30f11.png[/img]

Once you're happy with your level, upload it to the Steam Workshop. People can then use your levels in...

[h1]Private Last Bot Standing matches![/h1]

Create your own private Last Bot Standing matches with up to 15 of your closest friends. Download some new levels from the workshop and try them out!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/bc50e70b426aabc1f7456a9980aa404bc01bd2c2.png[/img]

Don't have any friends to try out new level with? Join our...

[h1]Live Community-Created Level Play Tests![/h1]

You may notice a new countdown at the top of the game.
