notes.title: Battle Royale Launches September 21st!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/f4b7c0334d918e7569eb9265e7a29c11b53fdd09.gif[/img]

Holy progress, Commentatron! There is so much new stuff from the past few weeks, we figured it’s way past time for an update post!

We’ve been working hard on creating a super fun Battle Royale game mode, and it’s turning out AWESOME! It’s hitting that point where play testing is becoming fun enough to become an actual development distraction (always a good sign).

If you’d like to try out the work-in-progress development branch with Battle Royale or otherwise follow ongoing development, check out [url=https://twitch.tv/doborog]Erik’s Twitch stream[/url] & our [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/multiplayer-test-builds/]development branch guide[/url]!

[h1]New Movement Mechanic: The Dash[/h1]

The [b]Dash[/b] ability will launch with the Battle Royale game mode, and will be available in all game modes (even single-player).

The Dash ability (SHIFT + direction) allows you to perform a quick, short leap in a given direction, provided you have the energy to use it. Combined with a well-timed swing (or used to avoid one), it can become a very powerful addition to your combat toolbelt.

It also makes you look pretty cool.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/aede33b0eea40cb4914ad1594938ee9b70517150.jpg[/img]

We’ve already been finding the dash’s quick, punctuated motions make combat feel more dynamic and fun, and helps avoid chase scenarios where both players are running at the same speed -- now there’s some excitement to it!

[h1]More Lag Compensation![/h1]

We’ve been continuing to improve the “hit feel” of multiplayer combat, and the Battle Royale update will introduce two major improvements: (1) cranking the server & client-side network send rate up from 20 packets per second to 60, and (2) using a hybrid client/server hit reporting mechanism that should help hits register more often while still detecting cheat attempts.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/98ea2d7943a26becde7cce618854659a6c9095c3.gif[/img]

Erik has been using this cool visualization of sword hit detection to test out different lag compensation techniques:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/2bc4529586d277283a9e55449b53796cf9002057.jpg[/img]

[u]Maybe in a future game, you’ll just draw flowers with your sword...[/u]

Beyond that, we still have even more ideas for how to improve the networked melee hit feel (including getting US-West region support, our provider suggests it’s coming soon!) -- & this update should be a nice step forward!

[h1]New Levels and Battle Royale Improvements[/h1]

Screw launching with one gigantic map, Clone Drone Battle Royale will will launch with a bunch of medium-sized maps!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/c0febcd4889100a3bca1bfe19c75d504aeba7a1a.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/6be83820b9243a190baa767b784258e2f84d1567.jpg[/img]

These maps will take advantage of some newly added level features, such as...

[h1]Laser Kills, Shrinking End Zones![/h1]

You may notice some levels have laser cannons on them.

Don’t fall off the edge of the map.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/afea3150eec03ce0114dac218144ecfd8f0ee6fb.gif[/img]

[h1]Spectate Mode[/h1]

Just because your robot body has been sliced to bits doesn’t mean you can’t keep enjoying the game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/ba9033477c68df89a5153c8b9f978d6023a6e808.gif[/img]

Now you can fly around, follow players and watch the game (starting with whoever killed you).

[h1]Level Editor Additions[/h1]

While we’ve been working on these new levels, we’ve been making some pretty cool additions to the level editor (which will become available to Steam Workshop creators when we launch Battle Royale)!

[h1]Multi-select, Align Tools[/h1]

What’s better than the ability to move an object? How about the ability to move ALL THE OBJECTS?!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/c968730e0e3147d0d86aa85e69d931c7a25edaa5.gif[/img]

Those of you familiar with Photoshop, Flash, etc. will appreciate these other handy tools which will be available in our next release (align, distribute, chain). Here are some outrageous things VastLite has been making with them:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/b97c0939ee217b3e7093e887a47e3f693b60b396.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/95532284f967ee86879820ce10f91817f89f1cd6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Move Groups[/h1]

When we added Moving Platforms, we were amazed and a little disturbed by what players were able to accomplish with such a simple feature.

Move Groups takes that to another level. You will be able to move not just platforms, but other objects in the level with these groups.

Look what X606 made using move groups (in the development test branch):

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/32cc41a0a055484736b73ca512e3ecf961251a51.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for the upcoming release of [b]Clone Drone in the Dancing Zone[/b].

Just kidding.

Maybe.

[h1]Playtest with us & let us know what you think![/h1]

Come [url=https://www.twitch.tv/doborog]watch Erik[/url] live-streaming developing the Battle Royale game mode LIVE! & join one of the [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/multiplayer-test-builds/]development branch[/url] test matches to try it out yourself.

Otherwise, see you in the arena [b]September 21st[/b]!

notes.title: Battle Royale is coming!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/811157c5a800e2975dbbe8f151b6708df067a66c.gif[/img]

Will YOU be the last human standing?
We're excited to announce that the next major multiplayer game mode will be... Battle Royale!

[h1]Wait... like... [u]another[/u] Battle Royale??[/h1]

If you're expecting 100 players to drop from a sky thing and then sneak around a large island with human houses... that is not what we're doing. :)

Clone Drone's take on the popular game mode instead builds on our learnings from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/763410/Long_Live_Santa/]Long Live Santa![/url], the merry Christmas game we prototyped last December.

We're placing a strong emphasis on fierce action, tactical trade-offs and contested upgrade drops.

[h1]Contested Power Upgrades![/h1]

Powerful upgrades become available after the match starts.
To get them you must be the only living player inside of their capture zone for five full seconds!

These drops help drive players together, providing an interesting trade-off between risk and reward. You can avoid the fight entirely with just your starting upgrades, but as more competitors are eliminated, you'll really wish you snagged some power upgrades!

[h1]Power Upgrade: Flame Raptor![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/0dd36eb6ff1b91da2eeacd3f41b474e3fef506a6.png[/img]

Have you always wanted to ride a fearsome fire breathing robot raptor? Of course you have.
Ridable Raptors is the first Power Upgrade in Battle Royale!

We're also thinking about the best way to introduce ridable raptors in singleplayer, but have yet to decide the exact shape that will take.

[h1]Power Upgrade: Mega Size![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/753bb50156f79a0ed014a9fb880aa5a7dfff6a94.gif[/img]

Tower over your enemies and strike them down with your superior reach!
It's fun to be a big bot.

[h1]Power Upgrade: Energy Laser![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/35bbcf1e45a8b209549dbfa00465f07354bd5891.png[/img]

Overpowered? I don't know what you're talking about.

[h1]Follow our progress![/h1]

Since multiplayer is way more fun to develop alongside real, live humans, you'll often find us developing it LIVE on Twitch -- and we've set up a beta branch where you can play along with every change we make. It's already getting quite fun -- come play and help us make it even more awesome!

[list]
 	[*]Watch us develop live on Twitch: [url=https://twitch.tv/doborog]https://twitch.tv/doborog[/url][/*]
 	[*]Join the Multiplayer Test Build: [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/multiplayer-test-builds/]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/multiplayer-test-builds/[/url][/*]
[/list]

See you in the arena, or for our next update post!

notes.title: 0.12.1 – Greatsword: The Lag Slayer
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/6261a851699bc985cf1e9530a573e92b69f25522.gif[/img]

On April 18th, 2018, the average time played for Clone Drone somehow went up from around 20 minutes to an HOUR.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/53c87523704c464fc70c34e3591a5fc4b00261a0.png[/img]

[u]What the heck happened on 4/18/18??[/u]

If you guessed "Doborog & co. launched multiplayer after 4 months of extreme game-overhauling development", you'd be right!!

While we've had a blast playing against everyone after launch, and many of you had kind words about the new game mode, the day after launch we were left not-yet-satisfied with the overall feel of combat. Multiplayer hits often felt unfair, random, or surprising. At times, it felt like the best strategy was to swing blindly and pray to the server gods!

Before moving on from 1v1 duels, we wanted to improve client and server performance and responsiveness, and make melee hits feel more fair and predictable.

A few weeks in, we've got a fun update ready with a game feel we are thrilled with. Improving combat feel will be an ongoing effort for us, and this should be a healthy start!

[h1]Introducing the Greatsword![/h1]

Replacing the old sword in multiplayer, the greatsword is bigger and has a longer windup time.

Why the longer windup? It gives us the power to compensate for lag!

[h1]The problem: Attacks landing at different times![/h1]

[u]"My sword passed right through them!"[/u] was a common reaction to our first version of multiplayer.

Although we used to start showing a swing right away on your computer, the server wouldn't start its swing until after receiving your computer's "swing now!" network event.
By the time the server tried to deal damage, your opponent might have moved out of the way!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/b6f3c3ed270f90414a64e44b946af0cbd743957f.png[/img]

What's worse -- when your hits did land, your opponent would often get killed before they even got a chance to see your swing start. [u]"How did that kill me??"[/u]

[h1]The solution: Eat the lag in the windup time![/h1]

Our goal is to make sword swings land at the same exact time. Your head should appear to fly off at the exact moment you see your opponent's sword pass through your neck.

To achieve this, we start with an alternative set of animations with a powerful windup sequence. Each strike takes note of and sends along its synced-up start time -- letting the server and your opponent both skip forward to the exact right time in the swing animation when they learn about it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/34fbc550f02cd682db3916063a4fcfd2861f6222.png[/img]

The result is that both you and your opponent see the strike land at the exact same time. It's like TIME TRAVEL FOR YOUR SWORD!

In play-testing, we've found it feels [u]much[/u] better than before, and results in many more epic moments of "OH GOD THE SWORD IS GOING TO HIT ME" (and then the sword hits you).
Let us know what you think!

[h1]The Greatsword Challenge![/h1]

Since the Greatsword has a longer wind-up and thus a new timing to master, you'll need some practice with it.
We've added a new Endless Challenge where every sword is a Greatsword!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/27c9e5f90d873a412f09774c65b21682a287049a.png[/img]

[h1]Multiplayer bow now works at close range![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/1753ba99d8ac8a1a25f7883f08f531f94e973289.gif[/img]

[h1]Multiplayer kicks feel better![/h1]

We expanded the multiplayer kick collision box and added lag compensation similar to that of the Greatsword!

[h1]Duel Invite Match Customization[/h1]

You can now customize the number of starting clones and skill points for custom duel matches!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/20a72649af8a6b0ec4133058eb4fd493ae1cf068.png[/img]

[h1]Optimizations and Various Fixes[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]Optimized the game to load 6 times faster and use 1/3 of the memory than before![/*]
 	[*]Made multiplayer jump pads trigger quicker.[/*]
 	[*]Optimized landing in lava to no longer cause extreme lag in multiplayer.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue where game settings could override system screen refresh rate.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed server crashes related to fire (aka "the frozen robot then server shutdown bug").[/*]
 	[*]Optimized server build so games start up quicker (and not cause lag on other games when starting up!)[/*]
[/list]

[h1]More fun stuff coming, stay tuned![/h1]

We have some exciting plans for the next multiplayer update. :)

If you're feeling extra adventurous and want to test bleeding edge versions of the game before the next update, follow our development [url=https://twitch.tv/doborog]on Twitch[/url] and watch for opportunities to try out what we're building next, live!

Today we launched 1v1 multiplayer duels!

And look -- our servers scaled up without exploding!

notes.title: Multiplayer Development Progress Update & 1v1 Features!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/55ee9232515d7fe157473fedf57e6680a5011310.gif[/img]

Ahoy friends! We're super hard at work on Multiplayer Duel Mode, but wanted to take a quick second to update everyone on our progress!

[b]tl;dr: We're making good progress! We're shooting to officially launch 1v1 in April (later than we'd hoped!), but in the mean-time you can follow along with [url=https://twitch.tv/doborog]Erik's live dev streams[/url] and try our [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/multiplayer-test-builds/]bleeding-edge development test version[/url]![/b]

[h1]What's Done![/h1]
[h1]The Duel Match Structure[/h1]
We're zeroing in on a final, fun match structure for duels. Each player starts the match with 3 lives, and after deaths, players get to pick an upgrade!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/856c36d70831a073d0cdc9918b3a7099fef0d45b.png[/img]

Picking upgrades after death adds another layer of strategy to the game, letting you react to your opponent's choices and the map you're on!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/75510cc683a5b4320b2cacb73943a6601e60c6d3.gif[/img]

[h1]Multiplayer-ifying Upgrades, Weapons, and Hazards![/h1]
As part of making the game work for multiplayer, we've been converting everything over to be multiplayer-compatible, including nearly every upgrade (hammer, bow, jetpack, kick) and hazards (sawblades, spikes, moving platforms over dangerous lava). While you may have kicked a Sword 1 robot or two into sawblades before, we're finding it's a totally fresh experience sending real human-controlled robots to their doom. Practice your maniacal laugh, you'll need it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/b15c79762f56f9bbe72396e4de734b62f10850f6.gif[/img]

[h1]Dedicated Servers![/h1]
When we built Long Live Santa! as a test game, we used a direct peer-to-peer connection for matches. While this worked okay (and cost a good bit less) -- players who were acting as the host would sometimes drop, some hosts would have inconsistent internet connections or high pings to others in matches, and in some cases use their position as server host as an unfair advantage!

For Clone Drone's multiplayer, we're pulling out all the stops and hosting our own full-on auto-scaling dedicated servers! While the development branch is currently targeting a single region (US-East), soon we will support servers in regions worldwide, so not only should gameplay be nice & fair, but hopefully pings will be buttery-low!
[h1]What's Left to Do![/h1]
While we'd love to launch right now, we've got some things to do before shipping multiplayer to everyone!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/687e0ebe1e7ab159df81c9713c32d23764afe41d.png[/img]

[list]
 	[*]Add some awesome multiplayer arena levels! While we have a few early level ideas, there's a lot of potential for fun new combat levels. Some will even take place outside of the classic arena![/*]

notes.title: Multiplayer Development Progress Update & 1v1 Features!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/55ee9232515d7fe157473fedf57e6680a5011310.gif[/img]

Ahoy friends! We're super hard at work on Multiplayer Duel Mode, but wanted to take a quick second to update everyone on our progress!

[b]tl;dr: We're making good progress! We're shooting to officially launch 1v1 in April (later than we'd hoped!), but in the mean-time you can follow along with [url=https://twitch.tv/doborog]Erik's live dev streams[/url] and try our [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/multiplayer-test-builds/]bleeding-edge development test version[/url]![/b]

[h1]What's Done![/h1]
[h1]The Duel Match Structure[/h1]
We're zeroing in on a final, fun match structure for duels. Each player starts the match with 3 lives, and after deaths, players get to pick an upgrade!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/856c36d70831a073d0cdc9918b3a7099fef0d45b.png[/img]

Picking upgrades after death adds another layer of strategy to the game, letting you react to your opponent's choices and the map you're on!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/75510cc683a5b4320b2cacb73943a6601e60c6d3.gif[/img]

[h1]Multiplayer-ifying Upgrades, Weapons, and Hazards![/h1]
As part of making the game work for multiplayer, we've been converting everything over to be multiplayer-compatible, including nearly every upgrade (hammer, bow, jetpack, kick) and hazards (sawblades, spikes, moving platforms over dangerous lava). While you may have kicked a Sword 1 robot or two into sawblades before, we're finding it's a totally fresh experience sending real human-controlled robots to their doom. Practice your maniacal laugh, you'll need it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/b15c79762f56f9bbe72396e4de734b62f10850f6.gif[/img]

[h1]Dedicated Servers![/h1]
When we built Long Live Santa! as a test game, we used a direct peer-to-peer connection for matches. While this worked okay (and cost a good bit less) -- players who were acting as the host would sometimes drop, some hosts would have inconsistent internet connections or high pings to others in matches, and in some cases use their position as server host as an unfair advantage!

For Clone Drone's multiplayer, we're pulling out all the stops and hosting our own full-on auto-scaling dedicated servers! While the development branch is currently targeting a single region (US-East), soon we will support servers in regions worldwide, so not only should gameplay be nice & fair, but hopefully pings will be buttery-low!
[h1]What's Left to Do![/h1]
While we'd love to launch right now, we've got some things to do before shipping multiplayer to everyone!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/687e0ebe1e7ab159df81c9713c32d23764afe41d.png[/img]

[list]
 	[*]Add some awesome multiplayer arena levels! While we have a few early level ideas, there's a lot of potential for fun new combat levels. Some will even take place outside of the classic arena![/*]
 	[*]Make all of single player work again! In the process of multiplayer-ifying everything, there are some things in single-player that need a bit of updating to work right again. On the bright side, this will make adding co-op much quicker once we get to that :)[/*]

[/list]
The up-shot of all this is -- once we've developed this core fighting experience, other game modes will become easier and quicker to add! We're super excited about what's next for multiplayer (and [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/2018/01/28/multiplayer-1v1-is-coming/]shared some of our ideas in this other post[/url]), and can't wait to start slicing you all in half with our laser swords.

notes.title: Multiplayer: 1v1 is coming!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/10300d7c63038a21179c91ee0bdcad63c3f08d8a.gif[/img]

Multiplayer is alive!
Soon the sword robots of the arena will be filled with human minds like yours.

[h1]We're starting with 1v1 Duels![/h1]
Our plans for multiplayer are far-reaching, but we're kicking it off with 1v1 Duels.
Two humans pick upgrades, then fight! Whoever runs out of clones first loses.

We're aiming to launch this to the world around [strike]late February / early March[/strike] [b]UPDATE: Now shooting for some time in April [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/597170/announcements/detail/1654382972067423829](more info)[/url], but come try the development branch now![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/8a5da67e477181926c9182d5229f9f9bdc42b2cb.gif[/img]

[h1]You can access the development branch![/h1]
Want to help test multiplayer? We're giving everyone access to the in-development version.
[list]
 	[*]Go here to [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/multiplayer-test-builds/]learn how to access the branch![/url][/*]
 	[*]This branch will be updated most weekdays, as we [url=https://www.twitch.tv/doborog]develop it live[/url].[/*]
[/list]
Right now it's a super-buggy, broken experience with terrible usability.
Nevertheless you can still try it! :)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/3f1886e91b52520272b23aea48792928c813ab0b.png[/img]

[h1]Features on the Horizon[/h1]
Multiplayer is going to grow and expand a lot over the coming months!
Here are some of the things we're going to be looking at:
[list]
 	[*][b]Ranked Ladder[/b] - A monthly ladder to climb! Rank up by winning, down by losing.[/*]
 	[*][b]Robot customization[/b] - Unlock cool skins by playing, and choose what your robot looks like.[/*]
 	[*][b]Emotes[/b] - Express yourself with useful phrases! A delightful combination of animation and text to speech.[/*]
 	[*][b]Play with your friends[/b] - Invite your Steam friends to play with you.[/*]
 	[*][b]Game Mode: Team PvP[/b] - Defeat the other team by achieving the map objectives![/*]
 	[*][b]Game Mode: Battle Royale[/b] - Fight until only one robot remains standing![/*]
 	[*][b]Game Mode: Co-op[/b] - Jump into Endless Mode with a human friend or take on Challenges together![/*]
 	[*][b]Custom games:[/b] Want to play a super strange workshop map? Custom games will be where this happens.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] The above items are not in order, and might change drastically. We'll make specific decisions as we learn what multiplayer is like and see what people love or hate about it.

Let us know what you would most like to see in the comments!

notes.title: Long Live Santa! is LIVE, Winter Sale, and Multiplayer!
notes.content:
Just over three weeks ago, we [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/597170/announcements/detail/1470852079244683765]announced[/url] we'll be tackling adding multiplayer to Clone Drone in the Danger Zone—and to learn the principles of multiplayer game development, we’d first create a simple test game.

Instead of throwing the prototype away, we decided to quickly publish it for free on Steam!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/c4a8f4cf88499b8fc7aa3ec3cef5c7ba871ec3b1.jpg[/img]

Less than a month after starting development, and just a couple days after launch, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/763410/Long_Live_Santa/]Long Live Santa![/url] has already been installed by over 40,000 players!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/4fc931fae0813caf7e4f1cc1c13a83779bd3edbf.png[/img]

Early reviews claim such [u]definitely[/u]-not-joking things as:

[u]“10/10 better than PUBG confirmed”[/u]
[u] “Definitely better than PUBG”[/u]
[u] “PUBG has a rival”[/u]

Thanks to all the wonderful Clone Drone players who helped beta test early builds and shared ideas and encouragement on our Twitch dev-streams!!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/763410/Long_Live_Santa/]Come play a quick free game[/url] while ‘tis still the season!

[h1]Lessons learned, now on to Clone Drone Multiplayer![/h1]
We learned TONS about how to build and iterate on multiplayer games from this technical exercise. The approach we took held up well—hitting over 400 concurrent players worldwide at once!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/a57b32bb886a6b66bb5fcad03a02550f7e9cc69f.png[/img]
Pungence Playing a Full Game ([url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=npFZnwQdV8E]check out his Let's Play![/url])

We’re now buzzing with ideas for ways to make a fantastic Clone Drone multiplayer experience, and we’re glad we took the time to “burn a pancake”—though some say the pancake is not so bad!

In January we will start designing and building multiplayer integration with Clone Drone, using what we’ve learned from building the prototype to make it amazing!

[h1]Steam Winter Sale: Save 34% on Game Copies![/h1]
If you haven’t yet had a chance to pick up Clone Drone—or are kind enough to share the secret simple joys of Clone Drone with a friend for the holidays—it’s currently 34% off, its biggest Steam Store discount to date!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/597170/Clone_Drone_in_the_Danger_Zone/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/8adfda63eaf31605a76aecda29048f428d35c317.png[/img][/url]

Now's a great time to treat yourself, be a hero, and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/597170/Clone_Drone_in_the_Danger_Zone/]grab a copy[/url] or two for some holiday training!

That's all for now, see you either [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/763410/Long_Live_Santa/]riding a killer reindeer at the north pole[/url], or in our next post in January about multiplayer development progress!

notes.title: Multiplayer is coming!!!
notes.content:
Ever since the game launched, multiplayer has been the number one suggestion.

In terms of adding value to the game, few features could have a larger impact!
It's a big undertaking for our tiny team, but we've decided that it's finally time to tackle it!

[h1]Here is the plan:[/h1]
[list]
 	[*][b]Now:[/b] Recreate the challenges Clone Drone will be facing in a separate little game.[/*]
 	[*][b]December:[/b] Launch this little game for Christmas (FREE!) and gather feedback on how it's working.[/*]
 	[*][b]January:[/b] Start multiplayer integration with Clone Drone, using what we've learned from building the prototype to make it awesome![/*]
 	[*][b]????:[/b] Launch it when it's ready![/*]
[/list]

[h1]Rapid Prototype: Santa goes to War![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/0bc2d4c7b44881b216a6ef1bcf70f587bc5e89fa.gif[/img]

We've never launched a realtime multiplayer game before, so we're going to fix that! :)

Who will be the next Santa Claus? The answer will be written in the snow with red letters!

We're aiming to release the prototype before Christmas, but if you wanna try it sooner check out [url=https://www.twitch.tv/doborog]Erik's twitch streams[/url] or the [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/discord]discord server[/url].

[h1]Multiplayer modes on the horizon![/h1]
Once we start building multiplayer in Clone Drone we'll probably start with a simple PvP experience, and launch it as soon as it's in a good state!

After that there are many options: Co-op, team deathmatch, ranked ladder, weird Twitch integrations. We haven't decided exactly what multiplayer in Clone Drone will look like.

What kind of gameplay would you be most excited to see? Let us know in the comments!

[h1]Other cool stuff:[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]There have been a ton of amazing looking [b]Workshop Maps[/b] recently! [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=597170&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems&days=7&actualsort=trend&p=1]Check them out![/url][/*]

notes.title: 0.11.0 - Twitch Extension, Cheer Bots and more!
notes.content:
A new update just landed and this one is all about Twitch Mode!

[h1]The Twitch Extension is here![/h1]
What enemies can you spawn? How many coins do you have?
For a long time the only way to find out has been to type commands into Twitch Chat, but that changes today!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/213e7d5e76a26e1af19b286e3b70b53426eca601.png[/img]

Sitting on top of the stream window, the new extension lets viewers interact with the streamer with unprecedented ease!

Want to try it? Install the extension [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/extension]here[/url], and download the latest version of the game!

[h1]Cheer Bots: Cheer for the human![/h1]
Want to support your favorite streamer through cheering in the chat?
The Cheer Bots are here to help!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/7ba4737a0a9e146165fd83b3e0e7279c96b245d5.gif[/img]

For every 100 bits cheered a Cheer Bot will appear with a wonderful present to help the streamer. Destroying the cheer bot gives you armor, clones, skill points or a powerful allied robot!

[h1]See who's streaming![/h1]
On Earth, streaming platform shows game.
In Robot Utopia, game shows streaming platform.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/ca38e63f568abfef6d96f17d88ef8d50a064618c.gif[/img]

Now you can browse live streams straight from the main menu!

[h1]Make some noise for your favorite streamer!!![/h1]
Everybody loves robots shouting at them, so we went ahead and made sounds for the subscriber emotes for as many [url=https://sullygnome.com/game/Clone_Drone_in_the_Danger_Zone/180/watched]top Clone Drone streamers[/url] as we could.

Here is a small subset of the many wonderful emotes that make noise now:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/42706499e7e002e480ec7c0febf936fd00465ef0.png[/img]

Send us an email at support@doborog.com and tell us who else should have their sub-emotes make noise!

[h1]Armor in Twitch Mode![/h1]
It's a small improvement, but now you can add armor to your robots in Twitch Mode. Doing so doubles their cost!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/72134dfca54a6adcf7385b695f7ed468e78dc1dd.gif[/img]

Let us know what you think of the new features, and go watch some streams at:
https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Clone%20Drone%20in%20the%20Danger%20Zone

notes.title: 0.10.1 - Too easy you say?
notes.content:
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/lookatthelava.gif[/img]

Hello humans!

Many of you expressed that although the Chapter 3 update was a lot of fun, it was over too quickly. This update builds on the new mechanics introduced in last update and adds a slew of [b]new content[/b] for you to play with!

[h1]Story Mode: A new experience![/h1]
All levels in chapter 1 & 2 have been updated with new maps.
We've mostly kept the ideas of the existing maps, but re-built them using the level editor to up their quality.

We've also introduced [b]Difficulty Settings[/b]!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/changedifficulty.png[/img]

If you've found Story Mode too easy try playing on [b]Hard[/b] or [b]Insane[/b].
The only difference is in what enemies appear on the levels.

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/insanedifficulty-1024x640.png[/img]

Chapter 3 also supports the new difficulty levels.

[h1]Endless Armor Challenge[/h1]
Do you wish every enemy in the game HAD ARMOR??
Try the Endless Armor Challenge!

We've also added a bunch of armored enemies to normal Endless Mode.

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/twohits.gif[/img]
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/ArmorTrohpy.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello I am Business Jetpack Bot![/h1]
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/businessjetpack.gif[/img]

Clearly the game needs a new jetpack bot wielding a fire sword.
[u]!spawn bjetpack Kappa[/u]

Speaking of fire, we've made it spread faster!
The slow creeping spread didn't feel good to get killed by. This feedback first surfaced in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/597170/discussions/0/1488861734109739218/]this forum thread[/url]. Thanks guys!

[h1]Bugs bugs bugs[/h1]
We also fixed a ton of bugs. Let us know if you find more!

[h1]Next up: TwitchCon![/h1]
Erik and Brian will be hanging out [url=https://www.twitchcon.com/]at TwitchCon[/url] this week. Look forward to some [url=http://twitch.tv/doborog]all day streams[/url] this weekend of random people trying Twitch Mode.

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/playnyc.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.10.0 - Chapter 3 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/level8loopfixed.gif[/img]

The wait is over, chapter 3 has landed! :D

Here is what's new:

[h1]Story Mode Continues![/h1]

Venture into the Fleet Communications beacon on a desperate quest. This is our most cinematic chapter yet, with many twists and turns!

[h1]Armor up![/h1]

The main new game mechanic this update is Armor.
Protect your limbs from being instantly destroyed by death robots!

Armor is available:

[list]
 	[*]In Story Mode Chapter 3[/*]
 	[*]As an upgrade in all non-story modes (Endless, Challenges, Twitch Mode)[/*]
 	[*]In the Level Editor: Check a box and any robot in the game is suddenly armored![/*]
[/list]

[h1]Rise of the Fleet Overseer![/h1]

Long did the voices cry out for some sort of boss. The Fleet Overseer is finally here to shoot a giant laser at those voices! BOOM!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/double-kill-2mb.gif[/img]

While she mainly appears in [b]Chapter 3[/b], other areas you can play with her are [b]Twitch Mode[/b] and the [b]Level Editor[/b]!

[h1]Allies![/h1]

A major new feature in Chapter 3 is playing with your trusty AI companion.

Stand back and watch them wreak havoc.

Allies are also available in [b]Twitch Mode![/b]

Simply type [b]!spawnally fleetoverseer KappaPride[/b] to give your favorite streamer a helping laser beam!

We initially restricted this to Twitch subscribers, but decided to open it up to everyone. Enjoy!

[h1]Aim Time![/h1]

Aim time is an awesome upgrade that's been in the game for quite a while now!

We've made it even more useful by making it not trigger automatically when you draw an arrow back. Instead: [b]right click to aim time[/b] with an arrow drawn!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/archers-aiming-down-1024x494.png[/img]

This has the great advantage of not wasting energy until you really want to aim, for all you energy-frugal archers out there. Hurray!

[h1]What's next: A small update with more stuff![/h1]

As is often the case, we could have easily worked on this update for another month without running out of high priority tasks to do.

But instead WE SHIPPED IT!
Being in Early Access we strive to deliver you a rough, but satisfying experience in a timely manner. :)

The result is that we have a few things we wish we would have had time for, that we're gonna scoop up into a [b]delightful update[/b] coming out [b]2-3 weeks from now[/b]:

[list]
 	[*][b]Chapter 2 Overhaul:[/b] The game has come a long way in terms of the quality of our levels. We redesigned all levels of chapter 1 for this update, but ran out of time to revisit chapter 2.[/*]
 	[*][b]Armor in Endless Mode:[/b] Endless Mode is completely untouched by this update. We're gonna fix that![/*]
 	[*][b]Level Editor items:[/b] We've created a ton of cool new assets used in chapter 3. Expect to see things like glass, doors, lights etc. added to the level editor in the next update![/*]
 	[*][b]General bug fixing: [/b]We know of plenty of bugs that we want to fix. If you find one email bugs@doborog.com[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Chapter 3 Teaser!
notes.content:

notes.title: 0.9.1 – The Twitchy Update: Suggest Workshop Levels, Big Stream Support, and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Panic-Gif.gif[/img]

Surprise, it's a mini-update!

While Doborog starts in on building Story Mode Chapter 3 (and [url=https://twitter.com/bcjordan/status/878634908314456064]begins teaching his own clone how to do things[/url]), we couldn't help but release our latest batch of Twitch improvements ASAP!
[h1]Share Your Workshop Levels With !suggest[/h1]
Sharing your sweet workshop levels with Twitch streamers used to be a pain -- you had to:
[list]
 	[*]Send your streamer a link (which would usually get auto-deleted...)[/*]
 	[*]Convince them to open a browser and subscribe to it.[/*]
 	[*]Hope and pray your level would eventually show up in the random Twitch rotation.[/*]
[/list]
Not good enough!!

Now you can send levels directly to your favorite Twitch streamer! Just type:

[b]!suggest [workshop ID][/b]

and streamers will instantly see:

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/queue-vote.gif[/img]

When accepted, levels will auto-download and become the next level in the rotation. Neat!

To get your workshop level's ID, go to its workshop page and grab the number from the id= part of the URL:

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/2017-07-13-21_59_26-Steam-Workshop-__-Hellgate-Endless-mode.png[/img]

So go to your favorite [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Clone Drone in the Danger Zone]Clone Drone Twitch stream[/url] and send em a level to try [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/workshop-endless]from the Workshop[/url]!
[h1]Level Editor: Twitch Spawn Areas and a Raptor Statue![/h1]
Tired of Twitch enemies spawning to their deaths or to un-reachable locations on your levels? Now you can configure Twitch spawn areas, so all Twitch enemy spawns on your level will target the areas you set!

[b]What you do[/b]: Just drag a few of these areas out, and Twitch enemies will spawn there!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Spawn-Areas.gif[/img]

[b]Pro tip[/b]: the vertical position of the spawn area is ignored, and spawn positions are found from top-down, so you can put these hints floating above the level if it's more convenient to lay them out like that.

[b]How it works on Twitch[/b]: when spawning an enemy, the game will randomly select one of the spawn areas you've laid out, and then randomly select a position within that.
[h1]"Remember Me" for Twitch Logins[/h1]
There's now a handy checkbox to save your Twitch username/auth token! No more fumbling around with your browser and clipboard when trying to connect live on stream.[url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Save-Login.png]
[/url]

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Remember-Me.png[/img]
[h1]Twitch "Up Next" and "Spawning Allowed" Notifications[/h1]
Twitch mode will now tell the audience what level is up next (and if it's from the workshop, a link to the level), and when it's OK to start spawning. Especially on big streams, it used to be hard to know exactly when to begin !spawning to get in before the limit gets hit.

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Spawn-Now.png[/img]

We've included a built-in delay roughly matching the stream delay so it doesn't spoil the outcome of the round you're watching.

Happy [b]!spawn[/b]ing!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Spawned-Enemy-1024x695.png[/img]
[h1]Big Stream Throttling & High Traffic Mode[/h1]
Before this update, Twitch Mode on gigantic streams would usually result in streamers being temporarily global-banned from Twitch chat due to high # of messages the bot would send in a short period of time. 😅

With 0.9.1, Twitch mode will queue and throttle messages to keep you under the 80-message-per-30-seconds-in-your-own-channel limit, and when things get busy, enter a [b]high-traffic mode[/b], where:
[list]
 	[*][b]!coins[/b] reports get collated and sent in batched reports.[/*]
 	[*]"Too many enemies have been spawned" messages show up just once per round.[/*]
[/list]
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Lots-of-Emotes-1024x638.png[/img]

[u]If you've got a really big stream and still see issues, email us support@doborog.com and we'll figure out how to tweak it to make it work for you! (And if you'd like to be added to our streaming press list for updates as well, let us know!)[/u]
[h1]Bug Fixes![/h1]
C'mon, you know we can't help smashing at least a few bugs!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Spidertron-Bug-Smash-1024x513.png[/img]
[list]
 	[*]Twitch Mode now shows "Now Playing" TVs and UIs, so you can tell which workshop items you're playing.
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/TV-Showing-1024x703.png[/img][/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug where endless workshop levels with multiple difficulties would always select the first difficulty, which resulted in hard levels in easier tiers![/*]
 	[*]"Workshop and Normal Levels" now alternate between workshop and non-workshop levels when they have been played the same # of times, instead of just playing a single workshop level and then only normal levels.[/*]
 	[*]The default endless workshop policy is now "Workshop and Normal Levels" instead of "Workshop only"[/*]
 	[*]Level editor: make zooming in exponential, so you can zoom in to see much smaller things.
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/zoom-in.gif[/img][/*]
 	[*]Fix rare crash that would occur when unsubscribing from currently played workshop level while in Twitch mode.[/*]
 	[*]If levels on the workshop have no enemies, the game will now skip the level & send us a report so we can investigate and remove them from the workshop.[/*]
[/list]

Go check out some [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Clone Drone in the Danger Zone]Twitch streams[/url] streams, find some cool [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/workshop-endless]levels in the workshop[/url] and suggest them! And watch for our next post with details on Story Mode Chapter 3, coming late August!

notes.title: 0.9.0 – 🔥 FLAME RAPTORS 🔥, New Challenges, and "Repair"!
notes.content:
[img]https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/clone-drone-gifs/RaptorRiderKill.gif[/img]

This release, we've added 🔥 FLAME RAPTORS 🔥, 2 new raptor-based challenges, and a "repair" upgrade!

[h1]Flame Raptors!![/h1]

Flame Raptors are the most versatile enemies yet -- they breathe fire:

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/raptor-breathe-front-1024x542.png[/img]

Enemies ride on top of them:

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/sword1-swing-above-1024x543.png[/img]

And they'll whip you with their tail!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/TailHit.gif[/img]

[h1]The Raptor & RAPTOR INSANITY Challenges![/h1]

We added two new challenges featuring the flame raptors:

- [b]Raptor Challenge[/b] - Ten fun levels with brand new raptor-appropriate layouts!
- [b]Raptor Insanity[/b] - A VERY HARD challenge. We decided to try splitting this challenge into an easy and hard version, since we know not everyone enjoys getting slaughtered repeatedly. ;)

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Raptor-Challenge-Trophies-1024x610.jpg[/img]

You'll also find raptor levels in higher tiers of endless mode, and you can even spawn them with riders on Twitch streams!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/twitch-spawn-raptor.png[/img]

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Twitch-Raptor-Kappa.gif[/img]

[h1]"Repair"[/h1]

Lose your arm, and can't use your bow? Tired of hopping around on one leg?

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Hopping-Leg.gif[/img]

Well, would you look at that!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/repair-upgrade.png[/img]

Weird -- wonder why there are scare quotes around "Repair"...

[h1]Other small improvements![/h1]

We also made a handful of smaller improvements we thought our wonderful fellow players would enjoy!

[list]
 	[*]Workshop levels can now use enemy deaths as triggers! (I think we may be getting close to Turing-completeness...)[/*]
 	[*]We fixed a bug with moving platforms resetting after death in workshop levels![/*]
 	[*]You can no longer escape your damaged robot body by exiting and re-starting the game -- player voxel damage now persists![/*]
 	[*]Hammer blows to enemies faces are now consistently lethal![/*]
[/list]

And as always, we're excited to subscribe to & play the awesome things you make next [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/597170/workshop/]in the workshop[/url]!

[b]Have fun with the raptors, and watch for our next post about what's next![/b]

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/bow-raptor-friends-1024x594.png[/img]

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Screen-Shot-2017-06-09-at-10.30.41-AM.png[/img]

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/mark3slice.gif[/img]

The update will feature an awesome new [b]Challenge[/b], as well as introduce raptors to [b]Endless[/b], [b]Twitch[/b] and [b]Workshop[/b] levels!

[h1]Story Mode is brewing...[/h1]
While we're working on getting dinosaurs to set you on fire, we have also begun concept art for the next Story Mode chapter.

Chapter 3 has been fleshed out on paper, and we'll start to implement it as soon as the raptor update is live! :D

notes.title: 0.8.2 - Level Editor Improvements, Bug Fixes, and Now Playing!
notes.content:
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/what.gif[/img]

An unannounced update?? Wha-a-a-a-t?

We decided to put out an update with some of the smaller bits and bobs we've been fixing since 0.8.1 so you can enjoy them NOW!

This update includes: [b]Level Editor Improvements[/b], [b]Bug Fixes[/b], and [b]"Now Playing" [/b]interfaces!

[h1]Custom Colors![/h1]
Now you can re-style any re-skinnable level item with the new Custom Color picker!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/picker.gif[/img]

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/2017-06-08-23_26_15-.eJwNyEsOhCAMANC7cAA-LS3gZQxBgiYqRDqrydx93LzF-6rPc6pF7SJjLsZsxyz92fSU_uRWdeu9nTW.png[/img]

[h1]The Corner Wedge[/h1]

Unassuming yet powerful, the Corner Wedge is perfect for smoothing out the sharp edges of level elements.

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/lonely-wedge.png[/img]

Resize it, and it still looks good. Wow!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/corner-wedge.png[/img]
And it comes in 10 sleek styles!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/wedge-styles.png[/img]

[h1]The Light Pillar[/h1]

It's light, in that it is lighter than the dark pillar. And it emits light.

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/light-pillars-1024x508.png[/img]

Pretty!

[h1]Bug Smashing[/h1]

We smashed a bunch of bugs!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/spidertron-smash.gif[/img]

[list]
 	[*]Head kills now require 3 or more head voxels to be damaged. Shave carefully![/*]
 	[*]Arrows you JUST deflected should not hit your body after deflection -- and, conversely, arrows that already hit you should not be deflected). Your death should feel normal! (We're still hunting down one more edge case of this, but should happen way less often. Holler if you see it!)

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/arrow-lol-1024x597.png[/img]

 	[*]Player movement while on overlapping moving platforms should work better![/*]
 	[*]Swinging [u]forwards[/u] with block arrows should now always block arrows in front of you.[/*]
 	[*]Free Clones at the beginning of the first plays of challenges should now be properly gifted! <3 <3 <3[/*]
 	[*]Author names for workshop items should now consistently show up.[/*]
 	[*]The Level Editor Inspector now SCROLLS! So you can now have a ton of trigger zones and be able to use them when configuring moving platforms.[/*]
 	[*]Mousewheel scrolling the level editor zoom is faster![/*]
 	[*]Mousewheel scrolling for the Level Editor Library now works and feels good! And doesn't zoom the level in and out![/*]
 	[*]Ctrl + D to duplicate does not pan the level editor to the left anymore.[/*]
 	[*]Restarting an endless playtest when you have upgrade points will now re-spawn you in the upgrade room (so you can use your points!)[/*]
 	[*]You can now type decimal numbers 0.___ in the Level Editor's Scale fields without it annoyingly putting 0.01 when you type 0.[/*]
 	[*]Have a ton of levels? The level list for the challenge creation screen now has a scroll bar![/*]
[/list]
Find a new bug or the recurrence of one we thought we fixed?! Upset we didn't fix the one that is bugging YOU? [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/597170/discussions/0/133260909499856654/#c133260909499869727]Send it along to us![/url] We'll make sure it's in our bug tracker, prioritized relative to everything else we want to add to / improve in the game, and Erik and I may even get around to SMASHING IT!
[h1]Now Playing[/h1]
It used to be impossible to tell what workshop endless level you were playing, let alone rate or unsubscribe from them quickly.

Now you can just check the TV:

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/now-playing-tvs-1024x487.png[/img]

Open the Escape Menu...

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/esc-now-playing.png[/img]

Beat the challenge:

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/2017-06-08-23_49_11-Unity-Personal-64bit-Gameplay.unity-voxelmech-PC-Mac-Linux-Standalone.png[/img]

Or just wait for the insta-voter to slide out after you beat the level! (Vote quickly using your keyboard!)

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/RateLastLEvel.gif[/img]

So efficient!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/597170/workshop/]Subscribe to a bunch of endless levels and challenges[/url] to try it all out, and share your opinion on workshop levels!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/597170/workshop/]http://steamcommunity.com/app/597170/workshop/[/url]
[h1]What's next??[/h1]
We wanted to get this mini-update out ASAP so you can start playing with it all now, but this is not all we've been working on. [b]The next major update launches on June 25.[/b]

And we're posting a preview of it... very soon! Watch out for it!

notes.title: 0.8.1 - They Wait
notes.content:
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/theywait3.png[/img]

It has been a week since the Level Editor was released!
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=597170&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems&days=7&actualsort=trend&p=1]The workshop[/url] now has 1500 items in it. Wow!

[h1]Update time![/h1]
Today we're releasing a small update reacting to feedback from all the wonderful people making levels!

It fixes a ton of bugs and introduces some fun new features.

[h1]Trigger Zones![/h1]
Now you can make enemies not blindly rush at you as soon as you exit the elevator.
Make them wait until you reach them before activating.

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Screen-Shot-2017-05-12-at-10.49.17-AM.png[/img]

[h1]Moving Platforms - Very Configurable![/h1]
You want to do cool stuff with Moving Platforms? Now you can!
By combining moving platforms with  trigger zones you can make all kinds of wonderful things.
Elevators, traps, doors, sinking pillars, self-assembling levels, hyper-mazes! You tell us.

notes.title: 0.8.0 - The Level Editor is LIVE!!!
notes.content:
[url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/editor.jpg][img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/editor.jpg[/img][/url]

FELLOW HUMANS. The time has come. We must now use our creative minds to construct arena challenges!

[b]Now YOU can make levels![/b]

Drag stuff around!

[url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/dragging-1.gif][img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/dragging-1.gif[/img][/url]

Make objects really big or small, or rotate them all upside-down-like.

[url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/place-rotate-scale-color.gif][img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/place-rotate-scale-color.gif[/img][/url]

Click Play, and test your level! You’ll have to beat it before publishing to the Workshop!

[url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/playtest-level-crop-even.gif][img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/playtest-level-crop-even.gif[/img][/url]

Configure your arena traps for maximum fun.

[url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/trap-config-2-small.gif][img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/trap-config-2-small.gif[/img][/url]

And now you can make challenges, and upload them to the Steam Workshop!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/challenge-upload-smaller.gif[/img][url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/2017-05-05-17_08_02-1.png]
[/url]

[url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/2017-05-05-17_07_16-1.png][img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/2017-05-05-17_07_16-1.png[/img][/url]
And when you're playing the game, you can now choose from a cornucopia of fun challenges and levels on the Steam Workshop!

Subscribe to a challenge and… VOILA!

[url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/subscribe-challenges-smaller.gif][img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/subscribe-challenges-smaller.gif[/img][/url]

And any Endless levels you subscribe to will show up while you're playing Endless mode. Configure that with this handy new Settings dropdown:

[url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/2017-05-05-17_31_39.png][img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/2017-05-05-17_31_39.png[/img][/url]
[h1]Also... a new thing![/h1]
What's this? It's a moving platform! Put some in your level!!

[url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/2017-05-05-17_37_37.png][img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/2017-05-05-17_37_37.png[/img][/url]
[h1]More improvements & guides coming![/h1]
We're really excited to see what you make! We're preparing more updates to the level editor, and plan on putting together tutorials and making it easier to get started with. We think it's gonna be... awesome!

In the mean time, check out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=918786457]this awesome How to Use the Level Editor guide by Captain Thore[/url]!
[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[h1]I’m playing the itch.io version (or Steam can’t connect), can I still use the editor?[/h1]
Yes! You can build levels and challenges, but can’t publish them (or download items from the Workshop) unless you have Steam running!
[h1]How do you move stuff around?[/h1]
Use the tools at the top of the screen. There are two moving tools, one that lets you drag it magically around, and another that lets you drag it along its X / Y / Z axes.
[h1]How do I delete levels, folders, objects in the game?[/h1]
Select the thing you want to delete, and press the Delete key on your keyboard!
[h1]Can I place as many enemies as I want?[/h1]
You can place up to 20 enemies. In most levels we’ve made, we try to keep it below 15. With more than 20 enemies the game gets laggy!
[h1]I found a bug, what shall I do with it?[/h1]
Send it along to bugs@doborog.com! We’ll be working on improving the level over the next few weeks!

notes.title: 0.7.0 – Kick Only Challenge + Photo Mode!
notes.content:
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/kickbot.gif[/img]

Human, there is a new update! If you have the game already, update now and give it a shot!

[i]Introducing…[/i]

[h1]Kick Bots! They kick... other bots![/h1]

The deceptively adorable kick bots run around kicking you into other enemies' swords, lava, and jump pads… that lead to more lava.

While they may appear at first glance too under-equipped to cause real harm, after a couple of kick-dips in the lava you may start to approach them more carefully.

[i]And you will encounter these deadly bots in...[/i]

[h1]The Kick Only Challenge - Look ma, no hands![/h1]

Using only your powerful feet, kick your way through 10 levels filled with spikes, fire jets, conveyor belts, lava and sawblades that will make quick work of your enemies (... or you).

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/kickonlyfirstlevel-1.gif[/img]

You look so happy with both hands free!

[i]And beating this challenge will unlock...[/i]

[h1]Power Kicks – Kick enemies into each other![/h1]

Just in time for bot-kicking season, the power kick upgrade both increases the intensity of your kick AND makes it knock back other enemies. And them, in turn, other enemies... I think you see where we're going with this. Line up a few robots and let them show you their best three stooges impression!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/powerkick3.gif[/img]

[i]And you can capture your own THIS IS SPARTAAA moment using...[/i]

[h1]Photo Mode: Take beautiful pictures of your trail of carnage![/h1]

[url=http://i.imgur.com/KRKipVN.jpg]Inspired by the wonderful YouTuber MattShea[/url] (who knows a thing or two about videogame photography!), photo mode lets you pause the game's action at any moment, pan around freely, and frame the perfect shot.

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/selfie-1-1024x642.jpg[/img]

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/excitedrunning-1024x692.png[/img]

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/being-a-trophy-1024x677.jpg[/img][img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/nearlydead.gif[/img]

Once you've got your shot lined up, you can take a screenshot (press F12 in-game if you are using Steam) and, hey, why not share your artistic creation with the world?!

We'd love to see your awesome photo-screenshots in:
[list]	[*]The [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/597170/screenshots/?p=1&browsefilter=mostrecent]Steam Community Screenshots section[/url][/*]	[*]The Itch forums ([url=https://itch.io/t/70351/post-your-awesome-photo-mode-screenshots-here#post-139735]guide here[/url])[/*]	[*]The [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/discord]community Discord chat[/url][/*][/list]

[h1]Robo-tography Tips:[/h1]

[list]	[*]Press Tab to freeze time and toggle photo mode on and off.[/*]	[*]Press ` (backtick) to wait for the next death to auto-trigger photo mode.[/*]	[*]Use your scrollwheel to control the depth-of-field. Experiment with how this affects your shot's framing.[/*]	[*]When time is frozen, left clicking will step time forward.[/*]	[*]Think like a photographer: is the framing of the elements in the shot balanced? Can you include the characters' faces to make it a more emotional photo? Can a viewer tell what is happening when they first look at this shot?[/*][/list]

[h1]And EVEN. MORE. OTHER. STUFF.[/h1]

In addition to those bigger things, we've continued improving the game's stability (& check out our new troubleshooting guides), and made a few handy tweaks:

[h1]Flame Breath: Overhauled to be more useful![/h1]

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/fire-breath-1024x731.png[/img]

While flame breath used to require a full 4-bars of energy to use, it now only requires 1 bar, and lets you stop breathing fire at any time without losing more energy. More control -- more POWER!!

[h1]Twitch Spawn Settings – Min difficulty tier for each enemy.[/h1]

Twitch audiences aren't always all !clones and Encouragement Cube!s. Now you can avoid getting crushed on level 1 bronze by hammer3s, spidertron6000s and jetpack2s, with these handy dandy new settings:

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/twitch-first-spawn-round.png[/img]

[i]And speaking of feature description transitions...[/i]

[h1]NOW YOU CAN KICK SPIDER-TRONS!!!!!![/h1]

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/takingyouwithme.gif[/img]

Watch out for the spider bombs!

Have fun, and let us know what you think!! And share your amazing photo mode screenshots with everyone!

notes.title: 0.6.0 - Where there’s Steam… THERE IS FIRE!
notes.content:
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/hypetrainonfire.jpg[/img]

[h1]WE ARE LIVE ON STEEEEEEAAAAAAAAAAMMMMM!!!!!!!!!!!!!111[/h1]

We are super excited to be here!

[h1]Did you buy the game on itch.io?[/h1]

Don't email us about it! :D
[u]Go read this guide for how to get your Steam key:[/u]
[url=https://itch.io/t/67604/how-to-get-a-steam-key-from-your-itchio-purchase-wont-install-until-316]https://itch.io/t/67604/how-to-get-a-steam-key-from-your-itchio-purchase-wont-install-until-316[/url]

[h1]What's new in Update 0.6??[/h1]

With that out of the way, Update 0.6 is here!
There are two major new features: [b]Challenges[/b] and [b]Fire[/b]!

[h1]Challenges[/h1]
Challenges is a new game mode that presents you with difficult tasks.

If you complete them you are given an awesome [b]Trophy[/b], a [b]Steam Achievement[/b] and sometimes [b]New Upgrades[/b]!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Screen-Shot-2017-03-15-at-9.07.59-AM.png[/img]

[h1]The Inferno Challenge[/h1]

10 very difficult levels introducing the Mark 4 fire enemies, fire traps and lava!!!
Expect to be set on fire and die repeatedly. :)

[b]Unlocks:[/b] Flame Breath!!!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/kicked-into-lava.gif[/img]

[h1]The Random Upgrade Challenge[/h1]

It's Upgrade Bot's construction day! 🎉 🎂  🎉
Celebrate by letting it choose your upgrades!

A nice trophy, and the happiness of Upgrade Bot is your only reward. <3

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/randomupgradechallenge.gif[/img]

[h1]Bow / Hammer Only Challenges[/h1]

Inspired by [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8XGk4s8bahg]REAL[/url] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r44_6LEJDRE]HUMANS[/url] on youtube, these challenges restrict your arsenal to a single weapon.

What's your reward for completing them? [b]FIRE UPGRADES!!! >:D[/b]

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/challenges_hammer.gif[/img]

[h1]Jetpack: NERFED! and also UNNERFED![/h1]

Two major changes happened to the jetpack:
[list]
[*][b]Nerf:[/b] The hammer now swings normally even when jetpacking. You can thank MattShea for highlighting the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1sFIbz7Juuo]extreme OPness[/url] of the previous version.[/*]
[*][b]Un-nerf:[/b] The jetpack now stops moving the second you let go of the key. This turns out to be very powerful, enabling you to dart forward in short bursts that you can time with your swings!!![/*]
[/list]
In the right hands this change could be even more deadly than the new fire upgrades!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/tacticaljetpack.gif[/img]

[h1]Endless Mode has a bunch of new levels![/h1]

Harvested from the Inferno Challenge, Endless Mode now has many things that are ON FIRE!

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[h1]Hey so I bought the game on itch...[/h1]

Read [url=https://itch.io/t/67604/how-to-get-a-steam-key-from-your-itchio-purchase-wont-install-until-316]this guide[/url]!!!

[h1]How do you use Fire Breath?[/h1]

Get the upgrade, then press F to activate it!
We forgot to make a tutorial. :P

[h1]What do I do now???[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Go play the Update! :D[/*]
	[*]Write a Steam review![/*]
	[*]Tell all your friends to get the game![/*]
[/list]

Thanks everyone for your love and support throughout this amazing journey.
We have many more updates in store for you.
